title: Risky Collateral and Default Probability
affiliations: University of Sussex Business School, Durham University, University of Padua - Department of Economics and Management, European Central Bank (ECB) and European Central Bank

detail.title: Risky Collateral and Default Probability

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: We use a novel data set containing all corporate loans throughout the Eurozone to document a series of novel stylized facts on the relationship between collateral and the probability of default. First, we show that the pervasive empirical finding that riskier borrowers pledge collateral is driven by economists’ informational disadvantage relative to banks. Accounting for time-varying bank- and firm-specific risk factors produces negative correlations consistent with theory. Second, the relationship between pledging collateral and the probability of default is non-linear. Increasing the ex-ante collateral-to-loan ratio initially lowers the default likelihood but increases it as loans become overcollateralized. Third, this is driven by the riskiness of collateral. We estimate that an increase in the ex-ante collateral-to-loan ratio correlates with greater variance in the underlying collateral’s market value after loan origination. We develop a model featuring risk-neutral agents and risky collateral that provides intuition for these empirical patterns. Pledging risky collateral lowers lenders’ expected returns in case of default, leading them to demand more collateral to originate a loan but this diminishes a borrower’s return when a project is successful leading to less effort and a higher probability of default.

AI.tldr: 本文使用欧元区企业贷款数据，揭示了抵押品与违约概率之间的复杂关系：风险较高的借款人提供抵押品的现象源于信息不对称；抵押品与贷款比率与违约概率呈非线性关系；抵押品风险性是关键驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 抵押品与违约概率之间有何关系？这种关系如何受到信息不对称、抵押品风险性和抵押比率的影响？
AI.motivation: 传统研究发现风险较高的借款人更倾向于提供抵押品，这与理论预测相悖。本文旨在通过更全面的数据和考虑银行与企业特定风险因素，重新审视抵押品与违约概率之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、抵押品风险理论、委托代理理论。文章构建了一个包含风险中性代理人和风险抵押品的模型来解释实证模式。
AI.method: 使用欧元区所有企业贷款的新型数据集，进行实证分析。控制时变的银行和企业特定风险因素，估计抵押品与违约概率的关系，并分析抵押品风险性的作用。
AI.findings: 1. 考虑银行和企业特定风险因素后，抵押品与违约概率呈负相关；2. 抵押品与贷款比率与违约概率呈非线性关系：初始增加抵押比率降低违约概率，但过度抵押会增加违约概率；3. 抵押品风险性是关键驱动因素：抵押比率增加与抵押品市场价值波动性增加相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 解释了传统实证发现与理论预测的矛盾源于信息不对称；2. 提出了抵押品与违约概率的非线性关系理论；3. 构建了包含风险抵押品的理论模型，解释了抵押品风险如何影响借款人努力水平和违约概率。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为银行信贷决策提供指导：应考虑抵押品风险性而不仅仅是抵押比率；2. 揭示了过度抵押可能增加违约风险；3. 为监管机构评估银行风险提供新视角。

title: What Can Undermine a Carbon Tax?
affiliations: USC Dornsife INET, Department of Economics, USC, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Institut d'Etudes Politiques de Paris (Sciences Po) - Department of Economics

detail.title: What Can Undermine a Carbon Tax?

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Several countries have implemented a carbon tax or cap-and-trade system to establish high carbon prices and create a disincentive for the use of fossil fuels. Essentially, the tax encourages firms to substitute toward low carbon emission energy. Costs also rise for firms down the supply chain that use production inputs with high-emission content, so the total impact of a carbon tax can be large. In practice, however, firms also have an incentive to find an offset to a carbon tax. In this post, based on our recent work, we present evidence of one such adaptation strategy. We show that French firms increased their imports of high-emission inputs from suppliers outside the European Union’s cap-and-trade system, known as the EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS), reducing the effectiveness of this approach to cutting carbon emissions—an adaptation strategy that leads to “carbon leakage.” To help stop this leakage, the EU is implementing a “carbon tariff” in 2026, which is the topic of a companion post.

To view post: https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2026/01/what-can-undermine-a-carbon-tax/

AI.tldr: 法国企业通过从欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）以外的供应商增加进口高排放投入品，以规避碳税，导致"碳泄漏"，削弱了碳定价政策的减排效果。

AI.motivation: 虽然碳定价政策旨在通过提高碳排放成本来激励减排，但企业有动机寻找规避策略。了解这些规避行为对于评估政策效果和设计更有效的减排机制至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 碳泄漏理论、企业避税行为理论、国际贸易与环境政策互动理论、供应链弹性理论。
AI.method: 实证分析法国企业在欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）实施后的进口数据变化，比较从ETS区域内和区域外供应商进口高排放投入品的趋势。
AI.findings: 法国企业增加了从欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）以外供应商进口高排放投入品，这种"碳泄漏"现象削弱了碳定价政策的减排效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了碳泄漏的实证证据，揭示了企业规避碳成本的供应链策略，丰富了环境政策与企业行为互动的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟2026年实施"碳关税"提供了政策依据，强调了需要更全面的政策设计来防止碳泄漏，确保减排政策的有效性。

title: What Is a Carbon Tariff and Why Is the EU Imposing One?
affiliations: USC Dornsife INET, Department of Economics, USC, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Institut d'Etudes Politiques de Paris (Sciences Po) - Department of Economics

detail.title: What Is a Carbon Tariff and Why Is the EU Imposing One?

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The European Union has been an early adopter of carbon policies, with the introduction of the EU Emissions Trading System (ETS) in 2005. This scheme sets a common price for carbon and is applied to the most polluting manufacturing sectors. By increasing the cost of emissions-intensive production, the system incentivizes firms to decrease their use of fossil fuels. However, as we show in a companion post, the policy’s impact was moderated by firms increasing their reliance on high-emissions imports. To eliminate this workaround, the EU will expand the ETS to imports in 2026, through the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM). The CBAM will essentially put a tariff on imported goods based on their carbon content. Our recent work provides a quantitative analysis of how the ETS and CBAM affect firms’ supply choice decisions, and the resulting changes in domestic prices and emissions.

To view post:https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2026/01/what-is-a-carbon-tariff-and-why-is-the-eu-imposing-one/

AI.theoretical_framework: 碳定价理论、国际贸易理论、环境经济学、企业决策理论、碳泄漏理论

AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了碳定价理论在跨境贸易中的应用，为碳边境调节机制的有效性提供理论支持，深化了对碳泄漏问题的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟CBAM政策实施提供决策依据，帮助企业理解政策影响并调整供应链策略，为其他国家设计类似碳边境调节机制提供参考

title: Beyond the Balance Sheet: A Discussion of Koenig et al.'s (2026) "Generating Societal Value from Natural Capital on Corporate-Owned Land"

detail.title: Beyond the Balance Sheet: A Discussion of Koenig et al.'s (2026) "Generating Societal Value from Natural Capital on Corporate-Owned Land"
detail.abstract: The growing adoption of Natural Capital Accounting (NCA) reflects efforts to integrate environmental considerations into corporate decision-making by rendering ecosystem services economically visible, particularly in land-constrained and biodiverse contexts such as Small Island Developing States (SIDS). Koenig et al. (2026) make a timely contribution by applying Corporate Natural Capital Accounting (CNCA) to compare alternative land-use scenarios on a large corporate-owned estate in Mauritius, showing that a low-density "Agrihood" development can generate substantial societal value while remaining financially profitable. While acknowledging the analytical rigor and applied relevance of their CNCA framework, this Discussion examines the policy, governance, and valuation implications of defining "societal value" primarily through monetary and utilitarian metrics. It argues that monetized valuation risks marginalizing non-market dimensions-such as cultural heritage, social equity, and relational human-nature values-that are central to societal well-being yet poorly captured by accounting-based approaches. Drawing on interdisciplinary literature in environmental economics, policy analysis, and social science, the Discussion advocates a pluralistic natural capital framework that complements CNCA with qualitative and spatially explicit community value mapping, embedded within supportive policy and institutional arrangements. The analysis further highlights the limits of voluntary, corporate-led NCA adoption in the absence of governance mechanisms that align private decision-making with socially optimal land-use outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论Koenig等人(2026)关于企业自然资本核算(CNCA)在毛里求斯土地开发中的应用研究，肯定其分析严谨性和应用价值，但批评其将"社会价值"主要定义为货币和功利指标的做法，认为这会边缘化文化、社会公平等非市场维度，主张采用多元化的自然资本框架。
AI.research_question: 企业自然资本核算(CNCA)框架在评估土地开发方案时，如何定义和衡量"社会价值"？货币化估值方法是否充分捕捉了社会福祉的非市场维度？
AI.motivation: 随着自然资本核算(NCA)的日益普及，特别是在土地受限和生物多样性丰富的环境中，需要评估企业自然资本核算框架在定义社会价值方面的局限性，确保环境决策能全面考虑文化、社会公平等非市场维度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境经济学、政策分析、社会科学中的跨学科文献；多元价值理论；社会福祉的多维度概念；自然资本核算的批判性视角。
AI.method: 文献综述与理论分析；对Koenig等人(2026)研究的批判性讨论；政策与治理分析；基于跨学科视角的概念框架构建。
AI.findings: 货币化估值方法会边缘化文化传承、社会公平和人与自然关系价值等非市场维度；自愿性、企业主导的自然资本核算在缺乏治理机制时难以实现社会最优的土地利用结果；需要补充性的定性方法和社区价值映射。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了多元自然资本框架的理论基础；批判性地扩展了自然资本核算中"社会价值"的概念化；整合了环境经济学、政策分析和社会科学的跨学科视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议将企业自然资本核算与定性、空间明确的社区价值映射相结合；强调需要支持性政策和制度安排；为政策制定者提供了改进自然资本核算实践的实用指导。

detail.title: The Macroeconomic Effects of Extreme Weather Events in Spain: A High-Frequency, Regional Approach

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Stability Mechanism Working Paper No. 74
publicationDetails.journalName: European Stability Mechanism (ESM) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Europe is already feeling the effects of a rapidly warming climate. Higher temperatures and severe floods, windstorms and wildfires have become defining features of recent years. But what this means for macroeconomic stability and policy is not fully understood. To shed more light on how extreme weather events affect the economy, we combine macroeconomic data at the most detailed regional level and at the highest temporal frequency available with high-resolution meteorological information for Spain’s continental provinces (NUTS-3 regions) from 2000 to 2022. This approach addresses the identification constraints and aggregation biases that have limited previous evidence. Panel local projections show that floods and windstorms trigger substantial and persistent contractions in real regional output per capita, while effects of wildfires are more limited. Extending our analysis to state-dependent local projections, we find that regions with high capital density, limited fiscal space or low insurance coverage see deeper and more persistent output declines, especially after floods. Thus, the effects of extreme weather events are genuine macroeconomic shocks in terms of their size and persistence. Sustained reconstruction support, broader insurance coverage, and targeted adaptation measures are hence crucial to increase macroeconomic resilience in the face of rising climate risks.

AI.tldr: 本文结合西班牙地区宏观经济数据和高分辨率气象信息，研究极端天气事件对经济的影响。研究发现洪水和风暴会导致实质性的持续区域产出收缩，而野火影响较小。资本密度高、财政空间有限或保险覆盖率低的地区受影响更严重。
AI.research_question: 极端天气事件如何影响宏观经济稳定性和政策？具体而言，不同类型的极端天气（洪水、风暴、野火）对区域经济产出有什么影响？哪些地区特征会加剧或缓解这些影响？
AI.motivation: 欧洲正经历快速气候变暖的影响，高温、洪水、风暴和野火频发，但这些极端天气事件对宏观经济稳定性和政策的影响尚未被充分理解。现有研究受限于识别约束和聚合偏差，需要更精细的数据和方法来揭示真实影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宏观经济冲击理论，将极端天气事件视为外生冲击；结合区域经济韧性理论，考察不同地区特征（资本密度、财政空间、保险覆盖率）如何调节冲击的影响；运用面板数据计量经济学方法进行因果识别。
AI.method: 使用西班牙大陆省份（NUTS-3地区）2000-2022年的最高频率宏观经济数据和最高分辨率气象信息；采用面板局部投影法分析极端天气事件对区域人均产出的动态影响；扩展为状态依赖局部投影法，考察地区特征的调节作用。
AI.findings: 1. 洪水和风暴会引发实质性的持续区域人均产出收缩；2. 野火的影响相对有限；3. 资本密度高、财政空间有限或保险覆盖率低的地区在洪水后产出下降更深且更持久；4. 极端天气事件在规模和持续性上构成真正的宏观经济冲击。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统量化不同类型极端天气事件对区域经济的动态影响；2. 揭示了地区特征在调节气候冲击影响中的重要作用；3. 为气候经济学提供了更精细的实证证据，克服了以往研究的识别约束和聚合偏差。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供针对性建议：持续的灾后重建支持、扩大保险覆盖范围、实施有针对性的适应措施；2. 帮助识别最脆弱地区，优先配置资源；3. 为增强宏观经济韧性应对气候风险提供实证依据。

title: Behavioral Drift in Modern Nursing Practice: Why Observation-Based Compliance Is Now Necessary

detail.title: Behavioral Drift in Modern Nursing Practice: Why Observation-Based Compliance Is Now Necessary

detail.abstract: Healthcare compliance programs have traditionally focused on documentation integrity, billing accuracy, and credentialing oversight. While these mechanisms remain essential, they are insufficient to detect a growing category of risk embedded in everyday clinical operations: informal nursing conduct occurring outside formal documentation processes. Modern nursing practice is increasingly shaped by high patient-contact frequency, informal oral communication, social media visibility, and reduced supervisory presence. As a result, boundary erosion, casual patient objectification, and informal disclosures may become normalized without triggering traditional compliance alerts. This paper argues that healthcare organizations must expand compliance infrastructure beyond chartbased audits to include observation-based behavioral oversight focused on nursing practice. Drawing on professional ethics standards, patient-safety literature, and contemporary operational realities, the paper proposes structured, non-punitive observation mechanisms designed to identify cultural drift before harm occurs. Positioned as a companion to existing frameworks for documentation governance and body-worn camera policy, this analysis demonstrates why informal nursing conduct represents a critical and underregulated dimension of modern healthcare risk.

AI.tldr: 本文主张医疗合规项目需要超越传统的文档审计，纳入基于观察的行为监督机制，以识别护理实践中非正式行为的风险。
AI.research_question: 医疗组织如何有效识别和监管护理实践中发生在正式文档流程之外的非正式行为风险？
AI.motivation: 传统医疗合规项目主要关注文档完整性、计费准确性和资质监督，但这些机制无法检测到日常临床操作中日益增长的非正式护理行为风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 专业伦理标准、患者安全文献和当代运营现实
AI.method: 提出结构化、非惩罚性的观察机制，作为现有文档治理和随身摄像机政策的补充
AI.findings: 非正式护理行为是现代医疗风险中一个关键且监管不足的维度，需要扩展合规基础设施以包括基于观察的行为监督。
AI.theory_contributions: 将合规理论从文档中心扩展到行为观察，提出文化漂移的概念框架，强调非正式行为监管的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗组织提供具体的观察机制设计建议，帮助识别边界侵蚀、患者物化和非正式披露等风险，防止伤害发生。

title: The Effects of Waiting Periods on Firearm Suicides in the U.S
affiliations: The Murphy Institute and Tulane University - School of Public Health and Tropical Medicine

detail.title: The Effects of Waiting Periods on Firearm Suicides in the U.S

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Suicide is often an impulsive act, and in the United States, nearly one-half of suicides involve a firearm, the most lethal and readily available method. In this paper, we use recent developments in difference-indifferences methodology to study the causal effect of waiting-period laws on firearm suicides. We find that waiting periods reduce firearm suicides among men by 1.5 deaths per 100,000 population, an 11% decrease from baseline. For white individuals, we observe a statistically significant reduction of 37.5 deaths per 100,000, a 37% decrease. For adults aged 55 and older, we find a reduction of 25 deaths per 100,000, representing a 40% decrease. For the overall population, we find a statistically significant reduction of 0.92 deaths per 100,000, a 12% decrease from baseline. Crucially, we find no evidence of substitution toward non-firearm suicide methods following waiting period adoption; among men, adults 55 and older, and white individuals, we find significant decreases in non-firearm suicides. We also examine the effects of waiting period repeal and find statistically significant increases in firearm suicides. Back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest waiting periods prevented approximately 3,000 firearm suicide deaths annually, yielding social benefits of roughly $41 billion. Our findings show that even brief delays in firearm access can disrupt the pathway from suicidal ideation to death, suggesting that cooling-off periods may be an important policy tool for suicide prevention.

AI.tldr: 本文使用双重差分法研究发现，枪支购买等待期法律能显著减少枪支自杀率，特别是对男性、白人和55岁以上人群效果明显，且没有证据表明自杀者会转向其他自杀方式。等待期每年可预防约3000起枪支自杀死亡，产生约410亿美元的社会效益。
AI.research_question: 枪支购买等待期法律对枪支自杀率有何因果影响？是否存在自杀方式替代效应？
AI.motivation: 自杀往往是冲动行为，美国近一半的自杀涉及枪支这一最致命且容易获得的方法。需要研究政策干预（如等待期）是否能通过延迟枪支获取来预防冲动性自杀。
AI.theoretical_framework: 冲动性自杀理论、冷却期干预理论、枪支获取与自杀风险关系理论
AI.method: 使用双重差分法（difference-in-differences）研究等待期法律的因果效应，分析不同人口群体（男性、白人、55岁以上人群）的数据，并检验自杀方式替代效应
AI.findings: 等待期显著减少枪支自杀：男性减少11%（每10万人减少1.5例），白人减少37%（每10万人减少37.5例），55岁以上人群减少40%（每10万人减少25例）。总体减少12%（每10万人减少0.92例）。没有证据表明存在自杀方式替代效应，反而非枪支自杀也显著减少。等待期废除则导致枪支自杀显著增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为"冷却期"干预理论提供实证支持；2. 证明即使短暂延迟枪支获取也能有效中断从自杀意念到死亡的过程；3. 挑战了自杀方式替代假说，显示等待期可能产生更广泛的自杀预防效果
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 等待期每年可预防约3000起枪支自杀死亡；2. 产生约410亿美元的社会效益；3. 为政策制定者提供证据支持等待期作为有效的自杀预防工具；4. 特别针对高风险群体（男性、老年人、白人）的政策设计建议

title:
With the People as the Rudder: On Monetary Sovereignty, Debt Restructuring and National Responsibility in Extraordinary Times
——A Construction of Ideological System Based on the Essence of Political Economy

detail.title:
With the People as the Rudder: On Monetary Sovereignty, Debt Restructuring and National Responsibility in Extraordinary Times
——A Construction of Ideological System Based on the Essence of Political Economy
detail.abstract: Starting from the simple perception of people's livelihood prices, this paper penetrates the superficial financial accounting and economic model myths and directly addresses the core contradiction of the concentrated outbreak of implicit costs in China’s economic development model, constructing an ideological system of monetary sovereignty and debt restructuring in extraordinary times with People-Oriented Nature as the core. Breaking away from the path dependence of traditional fiscal and taxation reform, this paper redefines sovereign currency as a People’s Contract, debunks the Accounting Illusion of "bank credit exhaustion", and demonstrates that debt restructuring under the modern sovereign credit system is essentially a political decision rather than a mere financial issue. It diagnoses that overdraft growth with real estate as the credit amplifier is essentially the rupture of an Implicit Social Contract, where residents overdraw decades of future consumption to finance public investment, and the mortgage crisis is the unfair sharing of development costs in essence. This paper proposes a Political Surgery scheme led by national sovereign credit, realizing the mandatory renegotiation of the broken Implicit Social Contract through targeted Debt Socialization—shifting the unfair costs from residents’ private balance sheets back to the national public balance sheet. Ultimately, it focuses on the ethical choice of choosing the lesser of two evils in governance, taking the value orientation of monetary sovereignty application as the ultimate touchstone for testing the People-Oriented Nature of the regime. Breaking away from the shackles of Western monetary and debt theories, this paper provides a Chinese indigenous solution to systemic debt crises, an ethical compass for the fair sharing of development costs, and anchors the essential logic that national credit serves people’s well-being. It fills the research gap of China’s indigenous monetary sovereignty theoretical system, enriches the core connotation of socialist political economy with Chinese characteristics, and possesses important theoretical originality and practical value for national governance.

AI.tldr: 本文从民生价格感知切入，穿透财务会计和经济模型表象，直指中国经济发展模式中隐性成本集中爆发的核心矛盾，构建以人民性为核心的非常时期货币主权与债务重组思想体系。提出由主权信用主导的"政治外科手术"方案，通过定向债务社会化实现断裂隐性社会契约的强制重议，为系统性债务危机提供中国本土解决方案。
AI.research_question: 如何在中国经济发展模式下，通过主权货币和债务重组解决隐性成本集中爆发的问题，实现发展成本的公平分担？
AI.motivation: 传统财税改革路径依赖无法解决中国经济发展模式中隐性社会契约断裂、居民透支未来消费为公共投资融资、房地产作为信用放大器导致的抵押危机等深层次矛盾，需要构建本土化的货币主权理论体系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 人民契约论：将主权货币重新定义为人民契约；2. 隐性社会契约理论：房地产透支增长本质是隐性社会契约破裂；3. 货币主权伦理：货币主权应用的价值取向是检验政权人民性的试金石；4. 会计幻觉理论：破除"银行信贷枯竭"的会计幻觉。
AI.method: 思想体系构建与理论分析：通过穿透财务会计和经济模型表象，进行概念重构（主权货币→人民契约）、矛盾诊断（隐性社会契约破裂）、方案设计（政治外科手术），构建中国本土的货币主权理论框架。
AI.findings: 1. 现代主权信用体系下的债务重组本质是政治决策而非单纯金融问题；2. 房地产作为信用放大器的透支增长本质是隐性社会契约破裂；3. 抵押危机本质是发展成本的不公平分担；4. 主权信用主导的债务社会化可实现断裂契约的强制重议。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 填补中国本土货币主权理论体系研究空白；2. 丰富中国特色社会主义政治经济学核心内涵；3. 突破西方货币债务理论束缚；4. 构建以人民性为核心的非常时期货币主权思想体系；5. 提供系统性债务危机的中国本土解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为发展成本公平分担提供伦理指南；2. 为国家治理提供重要理论原创性和实践价值；3. 锚定国家信用服务人民福祉的本质逻辑；4. 提供主权信用主导的政治外科手术方案；5. 为债务危机治理提供"两害相权取其轻"的伦理选择框架。

detail.abstract: Despite growing adoption and regulatory progress, significant concerns and doubts persist regarding the reliability and future of cryptocurrencies. In recent years, the cryptocurrency landscape has evolved substantially, marked by key developments such as the approval of Bitcoin (BTC) and Ethereum (ETH) exchange-traded funds (ETFs). These milestones may indicate a shift in the trajectory of cryptocurrencies, potentially altering their value, characteristics, and role in financial systems. This study investigates the validity of earlier empirical research through a replication analysis of four key studies. With this approach, one may assess whether earlier findings on asset class classification, portfolio allocation, fundamental valuation, and speculative bubbles of cryptocurrency market remain valid over a longer time period. Evaluating the robustness and relevance of previous studies is crucial, as it can help make more informed decisions within the rapidly evolving environment of digital assets. The results show that the earlier findings are still valid and demonstrate stability over time. As regimes and cycles evolve, our replications show that although "Crypto Currency Returns" fluctuate significantly, the story ultimately resolves toward Crypto Currency "Returns".

AI.tldr: 本文通过复制分析四篇关键研究，检验了关于加密货币资产分类、投资组合配置、基本面估值和投机泡沫的早期实证研究结果在更长时间内的有效性。结果表明，尽管加密货币回报波动剧烈，但早期发现仍然有效且具有时间稳定性。
AI.research_question: 关于加密货币资产分类、投资组合配置、基本面估值和投机泡沫的早期实证研究结果在更长时间内是否仍然有效？
AI.motivation: 尽管加密货币采用率增长且监管有所进展，但对其可靠性和未来仍存在重大担忧和疑虑。近年来加密货币格局发生重大变化，如比特币和以太坊ETF获批等关键发展可能改变加密货币的价值、特征和在金融体系中的角色。评估先前研究的稳健性和相关性对于在快速演变的数字资产环境中做出更明智决策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产定价理论、投资组合理论、基本面估值理论和投机泡沫理论，检验加密货币作为资产类别的特征、在投资组合中的作用、估值基础以及市场投机行为。
AI.method: 采用复制分析方法，对四篇关于加密货币资产分类、投资组合配置、基本面估值和投机泡沫的关键研究进行实证复制，使用更长时间的数据检验早期发现的稳健性。
AI.findings: 结果表明，早期研究发现仍然有效且具有时间稳定性。尽管加密货币回报波动显著，但最终结果仍指向加密货币"回报"的基本特征。随着制度和周期演变，早期实证结论保持稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了加密货币相关理论在更长时间内的稳健性，为资产定价、投资组合理论和市场效率理论在数字资产领域的应用提供了实证支持，增强了相关理论在快速变化环境中的解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、监管机构和市场参与者提供了关于加密货币市场特征稳定性的实证证据，有助于在快速演变的数字资产环境中做出更明智的投资和监管决策，增强对加密货币长期趋势的理解。

detail.abstract: The livestock sector faces global environmental, health, and socioeconomic challenges, requiring a shift towards more equitable and sustainable futures. Understanding academic literature on sustainable livestock futures is key to navigating the contested discourse across policy, practice, and society. This study takes a novel approach, combining topic modelling with framing analysis to explore the topic framing, thematic trends, and regional distribution of sustainable livestock futures research. This combined method offers a replicable, efficient way to navigate complex discourse and contested debates. We find literature remains dominated by techno-scientific and economic framings that prioritise emissions reduction, environmental management, productivity, and efficiency. These framings offer a narrow interpretation of sustainability, often overlooking deeper systemic issues related to equity, justice, and the role of consumption-side interventions, despite some growing interest in dietary shifts in recent years. The study also highlights the notable influence of the US, UK, and China in global livestock systems research, with major funding bodies and influential journals prioritising dominant narratives. Alternative framings and regionally tailored approaches remain underexplored and underfunded, highlighting imbalance in research priorities. Dominant narratives risk reinforcing incumbent systems, highlighting the need for more transformative, inclusive, and systemic research approaches.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用主题建模与框架分析相结合的新方法，探讨可持续畜牧业未来研究的主题框架、趋势和区域分布。研究发现文献仍以技术科学和经济框架为主导，强调减排、环境管理、生产率和效率，而忽视了公平、正义和消费端干预等系统性议题。研究还揭示了美国、英国和中国在全球畜牧业研究中的主导地位，替代性框架和区域定制方法仍未被充分探索。
AI.research_question: 可持续畜牧业未来研究的主题框架、主题趋势和区域分布是怎样的？这些研究框架如何影响对可持续性的理解？
AI.motivation: 畜牧业面临全球环境、健康和社会经济挑战，需要向更公平和可持续的未来转型。理解可持续畜牧业未来的学术文献对于在政策、实践和社会中导航争议性论述至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主题建模与框架分析相结合的方法论框架，用于分析学术文献中的论述模式、主题分布和区域影响。
AI.method: 采用新颖的主题建模与框架分析相结合的方法，探索可持续畜牧业未来研究的主题框架、主题趋势和区域分布。
AI.findings: 1. 文献仍由技术科学和经济框架主导，强调减排、环境管理、生产率和效率；2. 这些框架对可持续性提供狭隘解释，常忽视公平、正义和消费端干预等系统性议题；3. 美国、英国和中国在全球畜牧业研究中具有显著影响力；4. 主要资助机构和有影响力的期刊优先考虑主导性论述；5. 替代性框架和区域定制方法未被充分探索和资助。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了结合主题建模与框架分析的可复制、高效方法，用于导航复杂论述和争议性辩论；2. 揭示了可持续畜牧业研究中的论述不平衡和系统性偏见；3. 为理解学术文献如何塑造可持续性论述提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者、研究资助机构和实践者提供了导航可持续畜牧业争议性论述的工具；2. 揭示了研究优先事项的不平衡，呼吁更多对替代性框架和区域定制方法的资助；3. 强调了需要更具变革性、包容性和系统性的研究方法，以避免强化现有体系。

title: A Unified Portfolio Theory: Explaining, Unifying, and Guiding Portfolio Selection with Parsimony
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A Unified Portfolio Theory: Explaining, Unifying, and Guiding Portfolio Selection with Parsimony

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/a
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/a
declarations.funderStatement: N/a

detail.abstract: Markowitz Portfolio Theory (MPT) provides a normative framework for portfolio choice but falls short of capturing the heterogeneity of real-world investor behaviours. Recent research shows that two principles-Subjective Allocation Rule (SAR) and Minimum Tracking Error (MTE)-suffice to reconcile such heterogeneity within a single framework. This paper advances the argument from parsimony to completeness by establishing an axiomatic foundation that identifies allocation and mimicking as the two mutually exclusive atoms of active portfolio selection, and shows how SAR and MTE jointly explain, unify, and guide practices. The result is a practical, behaviour-consistent generalisation of MPT: a Unified Portfolio Theory.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一投资组合理论，将主观分配规则和最小跟踪误差作为主动投资组合选择的两个基本原子，为MPT提供了一个行为一致的理论扩展。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个统一的理论框架来捕捉现实世界中投资者的异质性行为，同时为主动投资组合选择提供完整的理论基础？
AI.motivation: 马科维茨投资组合理论虽然提供了规范的投资组合选择框架，但无法捕捉现实世界中投资者的异质性行为。需要建立一个更全面的理论来解释和统一各种投资实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于主观分配规则和最小跟踪误差两个原则，建立主动投资组合选择的公理化基础，将分配和模仿识别为两个互斥的基本原子。
AI.method: 公理化方法，从简约性到完备性的理论构建，通过建立理论框架来统一和解释投资实践。
AI.findings: SAR和MTE共同解释、统一并指导投资实践，形成了一个实用且行为一致的马科维茨投资组合理论扩展——统一投资组合理论。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了主动投资组合选择的公理化基础；2. 识别了分配和模仿作为两个互斥的基本原子；3. 提出了统一投资组合理论，为MPT提供了行为一致的理论扩展。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了一个实用的理论框架来解释现实投资行为；2. 为投资实践提供了统一的指导原则；3. 帮助投资者更好地理解和实施主动投资组合选择策略。

title: Machine Learning, Classification Algorithm and Cross Section of Stock/Bond Returns
affiliations: Victoria University of Wellington

detail.title: Machine Learning, Classification Algorithm and Cross Section of Stock/Bond Returns
detail.abstract: This paper compares models trained with classification algorithm with those trained using regression algorithm. We use technical indicators, 43 bond characteristics and 94 stock characteristics as predictors. We find very strong evidences of the superior predictive ability of classification models over regression models for bonds. All machine learning models for classification algorithm have statistically significant mean returns, unlike regression algorithm, in which only 3 out of 10 models are statistically significant. Classification models have significantly better results for the evaluation metric; mean bond return, alpha intercept, cumulative return, Sharpe ratio, maximum drawdown, zero return BETC and insignificant BETC. For stocks, we do not find strong evidences of the predictive advantage of classification models over regression model. For bonds, classification models are able to exploit the information contained in bond characteristics besides technical indicators, unlike regression models, therefore leading to significantly better results.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了分类算法与回归算法在债券和股票预测中的表现，发现分类模型在债券预测上显著优于回归模型，但在股票预测上没有明显优势。
AI.research_question: 分类算法和回归算法在债券和股票收益预测中的表现有何差异？哪种算法在预测债券收益方面更有效？
AI.motivation: 机器学习在金融预测中应用广泛，但不同算法在债券和股票预测中的相对表现尚不清楚。了解分类算法和回归算法在债券预测中的差异对投资决策有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机器学习预测理论，比较分类算法（如逻辑回归、决策树等）与回归算法（如线性回归、岭回归等）在金融时间序列预测中的表现差异。
AI.method: 使用技术指标、43个债券特征和94个股票特征作为预测变量，构建10个机器学习模型（包括分类和回归算法），通过统计显著性检验和多种评估指标（平均收益、alpha截距、累计收益、夏普比率、最大回撤等）比较模型表现。
AI.findings: 1. 债券预测：分类模型显著优于回归模型，所有分类模型都有统计显著的平均收益，而回归模型中只有3/10显著；分类模型在所有评估指标上都表现更好。2. 股票预测：分类模型没有显示出对回归模型的明显预测优势。3. 分类模型能够利用债券特征中的信息，而回归模型不能，这是分类模型表现更好的关键原因。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统比较了分类和回归算法在债券和股票预测中的表现差异。2. 揭示了分类算法在债券预测中的独特优势，可能是因为债券收益的离散性更适合分类方法。3. 为机器学习算法选择提供了理论依据，表明不同资产类别需要不同的预测方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为债券投资者提供了更有效的预测工具，建议在债券预测中使用分类算法。2. 帮助量化投资经理优化算法选择，提高投资组合表现。3. 为金融科技公司开发债券预测模型提供了实证依据。

title: Aiming High, Falling Short: Experimental Evidence on How Goal Rank Feedback Affects Goal-Setting and Productivity
affiliations: , Dongbei University of Finance and Economics and Dongbei University of Finance and Economics - Laboratory of Experimental Economics

detail.title: Aiming High, Falling Short: Experimental Evidence on How Goal Rank Feedback Affects Goal-Setting and Productivity

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest and any financial interest in the current study.

detail.abstract: Organizations increasingly use goal transparency as a management tool, yet little is known about how social comparison of self-set goals-rather than performance outcomes-affects ambition and productivity. We address this gap by investigating whether providing goal rank feedback leads to more ambitious targets that enhance productivity or distort goal-setting in ways that ultimately undermine performance. Using a real-effort laboratory experiment, we randomly assign participants to treatments varying in the availability and public visibility of goal rank information (no ranking, private ranking, or public ranking). We find that goal-rank feedback significantly increases goal levels but reduces performance. The negative effect of goal-rank feedback operates almost exclusively through women's responses. Despite similar upward goal adjustments by both genders, both private and public rank feedback reduce the performance and earnings of women but increase that of men. These gender differences in outcomes arise from divergent effort reallocation patterns: While both women and men maintain similar accuracy rates, men modestly increase their number of attempts in response to ranking information, whereas women significantly reduce theirs. Our findings reveal that transparency in goal-setting can create a wedge between ambition and execution, with particularly adverse consequences for women. Organizations should therefore consider the potential for goal transparency to backfire, especially in gender-diverse settings where unintended disparities may emerge.

AI.tldr: 研究通过实验室实验发现，目标排名反馈会提高目标设定水平但降低实际绩效，这种负面效应主要通过女性反应体现。尽管两性都提高了目标，但排名反馈会降低女性绩效和收入，而提高男性绩效和收入，源于不同的努力分配模式。
AI.research_question: 提供目标排名反馈是否会导致更雄心勃勃的目标从而提高生产力，还是扭曲目标设定最终损害绩效？这种效应是否存在性别差异？
AI.motivation: 组织越来越多地使用目标透明度作为管理工具，但人们对自我设定目标的社会比较（而非绩效结果）如何影响雄心和生产力知之甚少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 目标设定理论、社会比较理论、性别差异心理学、行为经济学中的激励理论
AI.method: 真实努力实验室实验，随机分配参与者到不同处理组：无排名、私人排名或公开排名信息，测量目标设定水平和实际绩效
AI.findings: 1. 目标排名反馈显著提高目标水平但降低绩效；2. 负面效应主要通过女性反应体现；3. 尽管两性都向上调整目标，但私人/公开排名反馈降低女性绩效和收入，提高男性绩效和收入；4. 性别差异源于不同的努力分配模式：男性适度增加尝试次数，女性显著减少尝试次数，但准确率相似
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了目标透明度在雄心和执行之间创造楔形关系；2. 识别了目标排名反馈的性别差异效应；3. 扩展了社会比较理论在目标设定而非绩效结果中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 组织应考虑目标透明度可能适得其反，特别是在性别多样化环境中；2. 管理者需注意目标排名反馈可能无意中造成性别差异；3. 在设计目标透明度系统时应考虑性别差异反应

title:
The Secret of President Park Chung Hee's Korean Miracle: 

An Emergent Development Perspective

detail.title:
The Secret of President Park Chung Hee's Korean Miracle: 

An Emergent Development Perspective
detail.abstract:
This paper unveils the secret behind South Korea’s economic miracle under President Park Chung Hee,
who transformed an impoverished agrarian society into a major industrial economy in under 20 years
through economic differentiation (ED). By aligning markets, corporations, and government to prioritize
performance-based incentives, Park’s policies—export promotion, heavy chemical industrialization
(HCI), and the Saemaul Undong—fostered a self-reliant, competitive spirit, driving nonlinear order-
transforming, emergent development rooted in complexity economics. His corporate-led prosperity
paradigm nurtured small and medium enterprises (SMEs) into global conglomerates, defying
mainstream neoclassical and socialist economic theories that criticize his approach as authoritarian or
market-distorting. Despite sacrificing short-term democracy via the Yushin regime to achieve long-term
prosperity, Park’s foresight in leveraging ED and anticipating complexity science principles, such as
synergy and the butterfly effect, offers a transformative model for nations seeking economic catch-up
or recovery from stagnation. This study critiques the misattribution of Korea’s success to export-led
growth based on comparative advantage, highlighting Park’s strategic industrial policies and contrasting
his achievements with modern global challenges of low growth and polarization in democratic market
economies, proposing his ED-based approach as a blueprint for global economic revitalization.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了朴正熙总统领导下韩国经济奇迹的秘密：通过经济差异化（ED）将贫困农业社会转变为主要工业经济体，强调绩效激励、出口促进、重化工业化和新村运动，挑战新古典和社会主义经济理论。
AI.research_question: 朴正熙总统如何通过经济差异化（ED）在不到20年内将韩国从贫困农业社会转变为主要工业经济体？韩国经济奇迹的真正驱动力是什么？
AI.motivation: 主流新古典和社会主义经济理论将韩国成功归因于基于比较优势的出口导向增长，或批评其方法为威权主义或市场扭曲。本文旨在揭示韩国经济奇迹背后的真正机制——经济差异化（ED）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复杂性经济学、经济差异化（ED）、非线性秩序转换、涌现发展、协同效应、蝴蝶效应、绩效激励理论
AI.method: 历史案例分析、政策分析、理论对比分析、复杂性科学原理应用
AI.findings: 朴正熙的经济差异化政策通过协调市场、企业和政府，优先考虑绩效激励，培养了自立竞争精神，驱动了基于复杂性经济学的非线性秩序转换和涌现发展。其企业主导的繁荣模式将中小企业培育成全球企业集团。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战主流新古典和社会主义经济理论，提出基于复杂性经济学的经济差异化框架，为经济发展提供新的理论视角，强调非线性秩序转换和涌现发展的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为寻求经济追赶或停滞复苏的国家提供转型模型，强调战略产业政策的重要性，为应对现代全球低增长和两极分化挑战提供蓝图。

title: Institutions, Growth, and Distribution

detail.title: Institutions, Growth, and Distribution
detail.abstract: This paper examines institutional requirements for economic development within democracymarket systems using the General Theory of Economic Development (GTED). GTED posits that growth and inequality stem from institutional functionality-economic differentiation (ED) versus economic egalitarianism (EE)-rather than regime type. ED rewards verifiable performance via markets, corporations, and governments, boosting incentives, innovation, and productivity. EE distributes resources uniformly, weakening motivation and leading to stagnation. A dynamic model formalizes ED's technology amplification (θ > 1) and EE's erosion (θ < 1), yielding shared growth or polarized stagnation. Empirical analysis of panel data from 66 countries (2005-2013) across non-democracy-market (NDM), young (YDM), advancing (ADM), and mature democracy-market (MDM) stages confirms GTED: ED drives GDP growth and reduces inequality in non-mature regimes, while EE induces low growth and rising polarization in MDM. Controls for corporate concentration, openness, and schooling reinforce findings. GTED critiques regime-focused theories, extending Schumpeter and New Institutional Economics by emphasizing corporations' role in ED. Policy implications advocate performance-based reforms in industrial, financial, and welfare systems to sustain prosperity in democracies.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用经济发展一般理论(GTED)分析民主市场体系中的制度要求，发现经济增长和不平等源于制度功能(经济分化vs经济平等主义)而非政权类型。经济分化通过市场、企业和政府奖励可验证绩效，促进增长并减少不平等；经济平等主义则导致停滞和极化。
AI.research_question: 民主市场体系中经济发展的制度要求是什么？经济增长和不平等是由政权类型还是制度功能决定的？
AI.motivation: 现有研究过于关注政权类型对经济发展的影响，而忽视了制度功能的重要性。需要超越民主vs专制的二元框架，理解经济分化与经济平等主义这两种制度功能如何影响增长和不平等。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济发展一般理论(GTED)，扩展了熊彼特创新理论和新制度经济学，强调企业在经济分化中的核心作用。理论区分经济分化(奖励绩效)和经济平等主义(平均分配)两种制度功能。
AI.method: 1. 理论模型：构建动态模型形式化经济分化的技术放大效应(θ>1)和经济平等主义的侵蚀效应(θ<1)；2. 实证分析：使用66个国家(2005-2013年)的面板数据，将国家分为非民主市场、年轻民主市场、发展中民主市场和成熟民主市场四个阶段进行检验。
AI.findings: 1. 经济分化促进GDP增长并减少不平等(在非成熟体制中)；2. 经济平等主义导致低增长和日益加剧的极化(在成熟民主市场中)；3. 控制企业集中度、开放度和教育水平后结果依然稳健；4. 制度功能而非政权类型决定经济发展结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出并验证GTED理论，挑战以政权为中心的发展理论；2. 扩展熊彼特和新制度经济学，强调企业在经济分化中的核心作用；3. 提供理解经济增长和不平等的新制度功能框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 政策建议：在工业、金融和福利体系中推行基于绩效的改革；2. 为民主国家维持繁荣提供制度设计指导；3. 帮助决策者识别和强化经济分化功能，避免平等主义陷阱。

title: Time to Accumulate: The Great Migration and the Rise of the American South
affiliations: KDI School of Public Policy and Management

detail.title: Time to Accumulate: The Great Migration and the Rise of the American South

publicationDetails.detailsText: KDI School of Pub Policy & Management Paper No. WP25-14
publicationDetails.journalName: KDI School of Public Policy & Management Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The idea that labor scarcity can induce economic development has long been hypothesized, but the evidence remains limited. This paper examines how the Second Great Migration (1940-1970) spurred structural change in the American South between 1970 and 2010. Empirical results using shift-share instruments show that out-migration incentivized capital investment and capital-augmenting technical change in the South that lost workers, increasing capital per worker and output in both agriculture and manufacturing. Labor was further reallocated from agriculture to manufacturing and local services. I then develop a dynamic spatial general equilibrium model that incorporates substitution between factors of production, factor-biased technical change, and factor abundance-based trade to characterize this process. The quantitative analysis indicates that labor-capital substitution played a major role in the adjustments to South-to-North migration.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了1940-1970年第二次大迁徙如何通过劳动力稀缺激励美国南部的资本投资和技术变革，促进1970-2010年间的结构转型。
AI.research_question: 第二次大迁徙（1940-1970）如何影响美国南部1970-2010年间的经济结构转型？
AI.motivation: 劳动力稀缺可能促进经济发展的假设长期存在但证据有限，需要实证检验这一机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于要素替代、要素偏向型技术进步和要素禀赋贸易的动态空间一般均衡模型。
AI.method: 使用shift-share工具变量进行实证分析，结合动态空间一般均衡模型的定量分析。
AI.findings: 劳动力外流激励了资本投资和资本增强型技术进步，提高了资本劳动比和产出，促进了劳动力从农业向制造业和本地服务业的重新配置。
AI.theory_contributions: 为劳动力稀缺促进经济发展的理论提供了实证支持，发展了包含要素替代和技术变革的动态空间一般均衡框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了劳动力流动对区域经济结构转型的影响机制，为理解区域发展不平衡和政策制定提供参考。

title: A New Paradigm in Macroeconomics Integrating Organizational Taxonomy through Sequential Mixed Methods
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A New Paradigm in Macroeconomics Integrating Organizational Taxonomy through Sequential Mixed Methods

declarations.ethicsApproval: This research represents the culmination of several years of independent scholarly inquiry, and I wish to express my sincere gratitude to the many individuals and institutions who contributed to this work in non-financial capacities. detail.abstract:
Problem & Motivation: For decades, mainstream macroeconomics has struggled to explain persistent development puzzles: why financially deep economies stagnate while banking-scarce ones surge, why financial literacy programs yield inconsistent results, and why similar policies produce asymmetric outcomes across nations. This research identifies the root cause: a fundamental blind spot in economic theory—the demography of organizations. We propose that economies are not mere aggregates of capital and labor, but complex organizational ecosystems whose gender composition and reproductive vitality dictate their growth, stability, and development trajectories.
Theoretical Innovation: This paper introduces a transformative theoretical and empirical framework that re-envisions macroeconomics through the lens of Organizational Taxonomy. We classify all economic entities into four gendered-demographic categories: Male (financial intermediaries), Female (productive enterprises), Barren (non-profit/government), and Non-Barren (for-profit entities). From this taxonomy, we derive the κ-ratio—the female-to-male organizational ratio—as a primal macroeconomic state variable. We demonstrate mathematically and empirically that deviation of κ from an optimal range (1,400–1,800) determines national economic destinies.
Methodological Breakthrough: We deploy the first integrated mixed-methods architecture in macroeconomic research: (1) Agent-Based Modeling explores complex organizational dynamics and identifies critical thresholds; (2) Dynamic Stochastic General Equilibrium formalizes equilibrium and welfare implications; (3) Econometric analysis tests predictions on a novel 120-country panel dataset (1990–2023); and (4) Comparative case studies provide deep contextual validation for Tanzania (extreme imbalance) and Germany (advanced equilibrium).
Empirical Findings: The global economy is in profound 327% organizational disequilibrium. The world κ-ratio stands at 6,830 versus an optimal 1,600. Correcting this requires the largest financial sector expansion in history: 2.97 million new banks and $29.7 trillion investment over 20 years. Our analysis reveals that:
•
The NB/B ratio (Non-Barren/Barren) is the strongest predictor of GDP growth (β = +0.247, p=0.023)
•
The κ-ratio exhibits an inverted-U relationship with stability
•
Financial literacy gaps enhance stability only when κ is low; in financially dense economies, they become destabilizing
•
Tanzania suffers 14,900% disequilibrium (κ = 225,000 vs optimal 1,500)
Policy Transformation: Achieving optimal organizational balance would unlock: 50% increase in global GDP (from $105 to $157.5 trillion), 180 million new jobs, and lift 500 million people from poverty. For Tanzania specifically, establishing 8,400 banks (from 56) would catalyze sustainable 9.2% GDP growth, elevate financial stability from 0.41 to 0.92, and generate welfare gains equivalent to a 164% permanent consumption increase.
Paradigm Shift: We propose nothing less than a complete inversion of economic governance: from price/output targeting to organizational balance targeting. Our policy invention includes κ-targeting monetary policy, gender-aware macroprudential rules, and spatial banking standards (e.g., 1 bank per 7,738 people in Tanzania) as mandatory instruments. This represents the birth of "Organizational Macroeconomics"—a new field where economic health is measured not by inflation or unemployment alone, but by the balance, literacy, and reproductive vitality of an economy's organizational ecosystem.
Contribution & Implications: This research provides the first unified framework integrating organizational ecology, demographic principles, and financial literacy into macroeconomic theory. It bridges micro-organizational behavior with macro-financial outcomes, offers empirically-validated development roadmaps, and establishes the κ-ratio as a fundamental economic variable with greater explanatory power than traditional indicators. The implications redefine economic planning, financial inclusion, and development strategy for the 21st century, offering a mathematically rigorous pathway to a more stable, prosperous, and balanced world economy.
To personal finance: A person should evaluate the value of k-targeting monetary policy, whether is self-propelling or financially dependent. To be self financially independent one should have male and female works.
Keywords: Organizational Demography, κ-Ratio, DSGE Modeling, Financial Inclusion, Economic Ecosystems, Gender Balance in Economics, Macroeconomic Taxonomy, Development Economics, Mixed-Methods Macroeconomics, Tanzania Development Model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出组织宏观经济学新框架，将经济体视为由四类性别化组织构成的生态系统，引入κ比率（女性与男性组织比例）作为核心宏观经济变量。研究发现全球κ比率严重失衡（6,830 vs 最优1,600），需史上最大规模金融部门扩张。研究通过混合方法验证κ比率对经济增长和稳定的决定性作用，并提出以组织平衡为目标的新经济治理范式。
AI.research_question: 组织人口结构如何解释长期存在的经济发展谜题？经济体中的性别化组织比例（κ比率）如何影响经济增长、稳定性和发展轨迹？
AI.motivation: 主流宏观经济学难以解释三个持久的发展谜题：为何金融深化经济体停滞而金融稀缺经济体增长；为何金融素养项目效果不一致；为何相似政策在不同国家产生不对称结果。根本原因在于经济理论存在盲点——组织人口结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织分类学框架：将经济实体分为四类性别化人口类别：男性（金融中介）、女性（生产企业）、不育（非营利/政府）和可育（营利实体）。由此推导出κ比率（女性与男性组织比例）作为原始宏观经济状态变量。
AI.method: 混合方法架构：1）基于代理的建模探索复杂组织动态和临界阈值；2）动态随机一般均衡模型形式化均衡和福利影响；3）对120个国家面板数据（1990-2023）进行计量分析；4）坦桑尼亚（极端失衡）和德国（先进均衡）的比较案例研究提供深度情境验证。
AI.findings: 全球κ比率严重失衡（6,830 vs 最优1,600），需2.97百万新银行和29.7万亿美元投资。关键发现：NB/B比率是最强GDP增长预测因子；κ比率与稳定性呈倒U型关系；金融素养差距仅在κ低时增强稳定；坦桑尼亚失衡达14,900%（κ=225,000 vs 最优1,500）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将组织生态学、人口学原理和金融素养整合到宏观经济理论中，建立"组织宏观经济学"新领域。将κ比率确立为比传统指标更具解释力的基本经济变量，连接微观组织行为与宏观金融结果。
AI.practical_contributions: 实现最优组织平衡可释放：全球GDP增长50%（105至157.5万亿美元），创造1.8亿新就业，5亿人脱贫。坦桑尼亚建立8,400家银行可催化9.2%GDP增长，金融稳定从0.41提升至0.92。提出κ目标货币政策、性别意识宏观审慎规则等新政策工具。

reference: KDI School of Pub Policy & Management Paper No. WP25-17
title: Delivering Against Populism: How Infrastructure Investment Undermines Extremist Politics in High-Need Districts
affiliations: University of Bern - Wyss Academy for Nature, KDI School of Public Policy and Management, KDI School of Public Policy and Management and Department of Political Science and International Relations

detail.title: Delivering Against Populism: How Infrastructure Investment Undermines Extremist Politics in High-Need Districts

publicationDetails.detailsText: KDI School of Pub Policy & Management Paper No. WP25-17
publicationDetails.journalName: KDI School of Public Policy & Management Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Can governments counter populist movements through public goods provision? We examine this question using Biden's Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act and the 2022 US congressional elections. Combining district-level infrastructure spending data with election results and individuallevel survey data from the 2022 Cooperative Election Study, we test whether targeted public investment can reduce support for populist candidates. We find that infrastructure spending reduced Republican vote share, but this effect was dramatically amplified in districts where (1) infrastructure needs were highly visible (poor bridges) and (2) Trump endorsed the Republican candidate. In high-need districts, infrastructure spending reduced vote share for Trump-endorsed candidates by approximately 5 percentage points more than non-endorsed candidates. This pattern reveals a fundamental tension in populist politics: populist leaders oppose government spending ideologically, even when their constituents desperately need public goods. Our findings suggest that well-targeted public goods provision can effectively counter populist movements by exposing the gap between populist rhetoric and material delivery, contributing to debates about how democracies can respond to the populist challenge.

AI.tldr: 研究显示，拜登政府的《基础设施投资与就业法案》在2022年美国国会选举中减少了共和党得票率，特别是在基础设施需求明显（桥梁状况差）且特朗普背书共和党候选人的选区，这种效应尤为显著。这揭示了民粹主义政治的根本矛盾：民粹领袖意识形态上反对政府支出，即使其选民急需公共产品。
AI.research_question: 政府能否通过提供公共产品来对抗民粹主义运动？具体而言，针对性的公共投资是否能减少对民粹主义候选人的支持？
AI.motivation: 民粹主义在全球范围内兴起，对民主制度构成挑战。研究政府如何通过有效的公共产品供给来应对这一挑战，对于理解民主国家如何回应民粹主义具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 民粹主义政治理论、公共产品供给理论、选举政治理论，特别是关于政府支出与选民行为关系的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用三重差分方法，结合选区层面的基础设施支出数据、2022年美国国会选举结果以及2022年合作选举研究的个体层面调查数据，分析基础设施投资对民粹主义候选人支持率的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 基础设施支出总体上减少了共和党得票率；2. 在基础设施需求高度可见（桥梁状况差）的选区，这种效应更显著；3. 在特朗普背书的共和党候选人所在选区，基础设施支出的负面效应被放大；4. 在高需求选区，基础设施支出使特朗普背书候选人的得票率比非背书候选人额外减少约5个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了民粹主义政治的根本矛盾：民粹领袖意识形态上反对政府支出，即使其选民急需公共产品。这为民粹主义理论提供了实证支持，表明民粹主义在政策交付方面存在内在矛盾。
AI.practical_contributions: 为民主国家应对民粹主义挑战提供了政策启示：通过精准的公共产品供给，可以暴露民粹主义言论与实际政策交付之间的差距，从而有效对抗民粹主义运动。这为政府制定反民粹主义策略提供了实证依据。

reference: KDI School of Pub Policy & Management Paper No. WP25-19
title: Democracy on Ministerial Selection
affiliations: KDI School of Public Policy and Management

detail.title: Democracy on Ministerial Selection

publicationDetails.detailsText: KDI School of Pub Policy & Management Paper No. WP25-19
publicationDetails.journalName: KDI School of Public Policy & Management Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Does democracy improve the quality of ministerial selection? A common view is that electoral competition produces more competent leaders and broadens the social backgrounds of political elites. Using newly compiled data on ministerial backgrounds in 141 countries from 1966 to 2015 with an event-study difference-indifference estimator, I examine how transitions to democracy alter the composition of executive cabinets. I find little evidence that democracies appoint more highly educated ministers, though they do replace individuals with military/police backgrounds with prior political experience. Democracy modestly reduces the share of ministers from upper-class occupational backgrounds, but this shift does not broaden professional diversity. Over the longer run, democracy is associated with a slight increase in ministers with political family ties, but not with greater regional favoritism. Overall, the effects of democracy on elite selection are more modest than often assumed, and patterns of elite persistence remain strong.

AI.tldr: 民主化对部长选拔质量的影响有限：研究发现民主化并未显著提高部长教育水平，但减少了军警背景部长比例，增加了政治经验。民主略微降低上层阶级背景比例，但未增加职业多样性。长期来看，民主与政治家族关系略有增加，但未加剧地区偏袒。
AI.research_question: 民主是否改善部长选拔质量？民主化如何改变行政内阁的组成？
AI.motivation: 普遍观点认为选举竞争能产生更有能力的领导者和扩大政治精英的社会背景，但这一假设缺乏实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 民主理论中的精英选拔理论、政治竞争理论、社会流动理论。
AI.method: 使用1966-2015年141个国家部长背景的新数据集，采用事件研究双重差分估计器分析民主转型对内阁组成的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 民主未显著任命更高教育水平的部长；2) 民主用有政治经验者替代军警背景者；3) 民主略微降低上层阶级职业背景比例但未增加职业多样性；4) 长期民主与政治家族关系略有增加但未加剧地区偏袒。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战民主必然改善精英选拔的普遍假设，揭示民主化对精英选拔的影响比预期更有限，精英持续性模式依然强劲。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据，表明民主转型本身不足以实现精英多样化，需要配套制度改革来促进更包容的精英选拔。

reference: KDI School of Pub Policy & Management Paper No. WP25-18
title: Legislative Gender Quota and Ministerial Selection
affiliations: KDI School of Public Policy and Management

detail.title: Legislative Gender Quota and Ministerial Selection

publicationDetails.detailsText: KDI School of Pub Policy & Management Paper No. WP25-18
publicationDetails.journalName: KDI School of Public Policy & Management Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Do legislative gender quotas undermine the quality of ministerial selection? While recent work shows that quotas expand women's pathways into government cabinets, critics contend that affirmative action may reduce competence, concentrate advantages among already privileged groups, or diminish professional diversity. Leveraging the staggered adoption of effective gender quotas across 141 countries from 1966 to 2015, I examine their long-term effects on ministerial selection. I find a modest, temporary dip in cabinet competence roughly a decade after reform, driven primarily by male ministers. I do not find evidence that quotas disproportionately advantage ministers from more privileged occupational backgrounds. I also find no evidence that quotas affect the professional diversity of ministers. Taken together, the results suggest that legislative gender quotas broaden women's representation at the top levels of government over time without significant adverse consequences.

AI.tldr: 立法性别配额制在实施初期（约十年后）会导致内阁能力暂时小幅下降，主要由男性部长引起，但长期来看能扩大女性在政府高层的代表性，且不会带来显著负面影响。
AI.research_question: 立法性别配额是否会削弱部长选拔的质量？
AI.motivation: 虽然已有研究表明配额制扩大了女性进入政府内阁的途径，但批评者认为平权措施可能降低能力水平、使优势集中在特权群体或减少职业多样性，需要实证检验这些担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于平权行动理论、政治代表理论和精英选拔理论，探讨性别配额对政治精英质量、社会阶层流动性和职业多样性的影响。
AI.method: 利用1966-2015年间141个国家性别配额制的交错采用作为准自然实验，采用双重差分法分析配额制对部长选拔的长期影响。
AI.findings: 1. 配额制实施约十年后内阁能力出现小幅暂时下降，主要由男性部长引起；2. 没有证据表明配额制使特权职业背景的部长获得不成比例的优势；3. 配额制不影响部长的职业多样性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为平权行动理论提供实证支持，表明性别配额不会显著损害政治精英质量；挑战了配额制会降低能力或加剧不平等的传统批评。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供证据支持性别配额的实施，表明这些政策能够扩大女性代表性而不会带来显著的负面后果；有助于缓解对配额制可能降低政府质量的担忧。

reference: KDI School of Pub Policy & Management Paper No. DS25-08
title: Demand for Decentralization? Evidence from Elite Municipality Administrators in Uzbekistan
affiliations: KDI School of Public Policy and Management

detail.title: Demand for Decentralization? Evidence from Elite Municipality Administrators in Uzbekistan

publicationDetails.detailsText: KDI School of Pub Policy & Management Paper No. DS25-08
publicationDetails.journalName: KDI School of Public Policy & Management Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Decentralization is extensively studied in developed economy and democratic contexts in relation to corruption and governance, often focusing on select countries. However, how and why some decentralization ideas get traction while others fall apart, and how this relates to democratization in closed authoritarian regimes is understudied. During the times of political openings, what we call "regime thawing," authoritarian regimes adopt and adapt democratic institutions. Using pre-registered randomized experiment with a large political elite survey (n=1,407) in Uzbekistan, one of the most consolidated modern authoritarian regimes, we find evidence in support for decentralization over policies but not institutions. Although the bureaucrats lose interest over institutional reforms that come with accountability to citizens (vertical), such as policy design levels, political elites prefer decentralization if this helps them define the deliverables at policy implementation levels (political oversight). We do not find that decentralization policies induce democratic institutional attitudes. We provide novel evidence on how decentralization can happen under authoritarian regimes and help them, while not endangering the regime stability.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过乌兹别克斯坦的随机实验发现，在威权体制下，政治精英支持政策层面的分权（有助于他们控制政策实施），但不支持制度层面的分权（因为涉及对公民的问责）。分权改革不会威胁政权稳定，反而可能帮助威权政权。
AI.research_question: 在封闭的威权政权中，为什么某些分权理念能够获得支持而其他则失败？分权如何与威权背景下的民主化相关？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注发达经济和民主背景下的分权与腐败治理，对威权政权中分权理念如何获得支持、以及分权与民主化关系的研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: "政权解冻"理论（regime thawing）- 威权政权在政治开放时期采纳和调整民主制度；分权理论在威权背景下的应用。
AI.method: 预注册随机实验，对乌兹别克斯坦（现代威权政权）的1407名政治精英进行大规模调查。
AI.findings: 1. 官僚对涉及公民问责（垂直问责）的制度改革失去兴趣；2. 政治精英偏好有助于他们在政策实施层面定义交付成果的分权（政治监督）；3. 分权政策不会诱导民主制度态度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了威权政权下分权如何发生的新证据，解释了分权如何帮助威权政权而不威胁其稳定，扩展了"政权解冻"理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为威权政权设计分权改革提供实践指导，帮助理解哪些分权措施可能获得精英支持而不威胁政权稳定。

reference: KDI School of Pub Policy & Management Paper No. WP25-15
title: Risk Attitude and Complex Lotteries
affiliations: KDI School of Public Policy and Management, University of Iowa - Henry B. Tippie College of Business - Department of Economics, Michigan State University and KDI School of Public Policy and Management

detail.title: Risk Attitude and Complex Lotteries

publicationDetails.detailsText: KDI School of Pub Policy & Management Paper No. WP25-15
publicationDetails.journalName: KDI School of Public Policy & Management Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper investigates how complexity affects individual risk attitudes in a laboratory experiment. While previous studies examined this question using expected utility (EU) models in lottery settings, we use both the EU and the Quantile Preferences (QP) models. The QP model identifies risk attitudes without relying on parametric assumptions about utility functions. In our experiment, complexity is defined along two dimensions: (1) the number of lotteries and (2) the number of outcome-probability pairs. The results show that, as complexity increases, EU estimates exhibit decreasing risk aversion and greater volatility, whereas QP yields more stable estimates with slightly increasing risk aversion.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验室实验研究复杂性如何影响个体风险态度。与以往使用期望效用模型的研究不同，本文同时采用期望效用和分位数偏好模型，后者无需对效用函数做参数假设。研究发现，随着复杂性增加，EU估计显示风险厌恶下降且波动性增大，而QP估计更稳定且风险厌恶略有上升。
AI.research_question: 复杂性如何影响个体的风险态度？具体而言，彩票数量和结果-概率对数量这两个维度的复杂性如何改变风险偏好的测量？
AI.motivation: 以往研究主要使用期望效用模型在彩票设置中考察复杂性对风险态度的影响，但EU模型需要参数化假设。需要采用更稳健的方法（如分位数偏好模型）来更准确地测量复杂性对风险态度的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 期望效用理论（Expected Utility Theory）：传统风险决策理论
2. 分位数偏好模型（Quantile Preferences Model）：无需参数化效用函数假设的风险态度测量方法
AI.method: 实验室实验方法，通过控制两个维度的复杂性：（1）彩票数量；（2）结果-概率对数量。同时使用EU和QP模型分析实验数据。
AI.findings: 随着复杂性增加，EU模型的估计显示风险厌恶程度下降且波动性增大；而QP模型的估计更加稳定，风险厌恶程度略有上升。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 首次同时使用EU和QP模型研究复杂性对风险态度的影响
2. 证明QP模型在复杂环境下比EU模型更稳健
3. 为风险态度测量提供了新的理论框架和方法论
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为金融决策、保险设计等实际应用提供更准确的风险态度测量方法
2. 帮助政策制定者更好地理解复杂环境下个体的风险决策行为

title: What Makes Individual I 's a Collective We; Coordination Mechanisms & Costs
affiliations: KDI School of Public Policy and Management, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management, Santa Fe Institute, Northwestern University - Northwestern Institute for Complex Systems (NICO) and Seoul National University

detail.title: What Makes Individual I 's a Collective We; Coordination Mechanisms & Costs

publicationDetails.detailsText: KDI School of Pub Policy & Management Paper No. WP25-20
publicationDetails.journalName: KDI School of Public Policy & Management Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The collective effort exceeds the sum of its parts when individuals coordinate and regulate their activities and behaviors. This holds true even in self-organizing systems with open, voluntary participation where coordination occurs implicitly. Here, we analyze the non-functional actions of contributors, administrators, and bots on Wikipedia, categorizing them by their asymmetric authority: one-way oversight and two-way. This categorization helps us reveal comparable patterns. First, we find remarkably consistent scaling factors for each category relative to system size. Two-way coordination scales superlinearly (with an exponent of 1.3), while oversight coordination grows sublinearly (with an exponent of 0.9), suggesting an underlying mechanism for coordination across communities. Second, we identify the hierarchical modular structure of interactions as a key factor for the economy of scale in coordination, and we propose a mathematical model to explain these results. Finally, our temporal analysis shows a shift from two-way interactions to one-way oversight as system size increases. This suggests the emergence of a nascent hierarchical structure even in self-organizing systems, echoing Weber's theory of organizational evolution.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了维基百科上贡献者、管理员和机器人的非功能性行为，发现协调活动呈现规律性缩放模式：双向协调呈超线性增长（指数1.3），监督协调呈次线性增长（指数0.9）。研究揭示了层级模块化结构对协调规模经济的关键作用，并发现随着系统规模增大，双向互动向单向监督转变，体现了自组织系统中层级结构的自发涌现。
AI.research_question: 在维基百科这样的自组织系统中，非功能性协调活动（如监督、管理）如何随系统规模变化？这些协调模式反映了什么样的组织结构演化规律？
AI.motivation: 理解自组织系统中协调活动的缩放规律，揭示即使在没有正式层级结构的开放协作系统中，协调活动如何自发组织并形成效率模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 韦伯的组织演化理论，自组织系统理论，协调经济学，层级模块化结构理论。
AI.method: 分析维基百科上贡献者、管理员和机器人的非功能性行为数据，按不对称权威（单向监督和双向协调）分类，使用缩放分析、层级模块化结构识别和数学模型构建。
AI.findings:
1. 协调活动呈现规律性缩放：双向协调呈超线性增长（指数1.3），监督协调呈次线性增长（指数0.9）
2. 层级模块化结构是实现协调规模经济的关键因素
3. 随着系统规模增大，双向互动向单向监督转变，表明层级结构的自发涌现
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 为自组织系统中的协调活动提供了量化缩放规律
2. 揭示了层级结构在自组织系统中的自发涌现机制
3. 将韦伯的组织演化理论扩展到非正式协作系统
4. 提出了解释协调规模经济的数学模型
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为在线协作平台的设计提供优化建议
2. 帮助预测大规模协作系统中的协调需求
3. 为自组织系统的治理结构设计提供实证依据
4. 为机器人参与协调活动的设计提供指导

title: When Foreign Investment Counters the Populist Backlash: County-level Evidence from US Presidential Elections
affiliations: KDI School of Public Policy and Management, KDI School of Public Policy and Management and Department of Political Science and International Relations

detail.title: When Foreign Investment Counters the Populist Backlash: County-level Evidence from US Presidential Elections

publicationDetails.detailsText: KDI School of Pub Policy & Management Paper No. WP25-16
publicationDetails.journalName: KDI School of Public Policy & Management Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Globalization creates both losers and winners, yet research on its political consequences has focused almost exclusively on economic losers. We examine the other side: as the world's largest FDI recipient, the US has attracted foreign multinationals that generate millions of local jobs, pay wage premiums, and bring skilled international workers into local communities. We argue that residents of FDI-receiving localities-uniquely positioned to experience the material benefits of global economic integration-are less likely to support anti-establishment candidates. Analyzing county-level data from 2008-2020, we find that FDI-generated employment significantly reduced vote swings toward Trump in 2016, particularly in counties with high job losses among white and male workers in rural areas. Where globalization delivers tangible local prosperity, it builds political resilience against populist backlash.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，作为外国直接投资（FDI）接收地的美国县区，由于FDI创造了就业、支付工资溢价并引入国际技术工人，当地居民更少支持反建制候选人（如特朗普），尤其是在白人男性工人失业严重的农村地区。全球化带来的地方繁荣能增强政治韧性，抵御民粹主义反弹。
AI.research_question: 外国直接投资（FDI）接收地的居民是否更少支持反建制候选人？全球化带来的地方经济收益是否能增强政治韧性，抵御民粹主义反弹？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注全球化中的经济失败者（losers），而忽视了全球化受益者（winners）的政治态度。作为全球最大FDI接收国，美国吸引了大量外国跨国公司，创造了数百万本地就业、支付工资溢价并引入国际技术工人，这些地方居民的政治态度值得研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济投票理论（economic voting theory）和全球化政治后果研究，提出"地方繁荣假说"：当全球化带来切实的地方经济收益时，居民会减少对反建制候选人的支持。
AI.method: 使用2008-2020年美国县级数据，分析FDI创造的就业对2016年特朗普选票摇摆的影响。特别关注白人男性工人失业严重的农村县区，采用统计分析方法检验假设。
AI.findings: FDI创造的就业显著减少了2016年特朗普的选票摇摆，特别是在白人男性工人失业严重的农村县区。全球化带来的地方繁荣确实能增强政治韧性，抵御民粹主义反弹。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将研究焦点从全球化失败者转向受益者；2）提出"地方繁荣假说"解释全球化政治后果；3）丰富了经济投票理论在全球化背景下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供证据：促进FDI和全球化可以增强政治稳定；2）帮助理解民粹主义反弹的地区差异；3）为跨国公司社会责任提供政治经济学视角。

title: SBCM Economics: A Meso-Economic Framework for Maximizing Wealth Retention and Circulation -Redefining Regional Economic Cycles and Fiscal Multipliers via Standard

detail.title: SBCM Economics: A Meso-Economic Framework for Maximizing Wealth Retention and Circulation -Redefining Regional Economic Cycles and Fiscal Multipliers via Standard

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This research analyzes publicly available open data.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this work.

detail.abstract: Traditional economics has long been bifurcated into "Macroeconomics" (dealing with nations) and "Microeconomics" (dealing with individuals/firms). However, there is a critical theoretical gap in the "Meso-Economics" domain, which deals with the "Basic Municipality (Standard Block)," the actual unit of administrative service and community life. This paper applies the Standard Block Comparison Method (SBCM) to economic theory to propose a new framework. We demonstrate mathematically that maximizing "Wealth Retention ()" rather than "Gross Domestic Product (GDP)" is the only sustainable path for aging societies. Furthermore, we define the "SBCM Fiscal Multiplier ()," revealing that high-budget public works with high distortion () often result in negative economic effects due to leakage (the Straw Effect).

AI.tldr: 本文提出中观经济学框架，应用标准区块比较法，证明老龄化社会应最大化财富保留而非GDP，并揭示高预算公共工程因扭曲和漏出效应可能导致负面经济影响
AI.research_question: 如何构建中观经济学理论框架，以标准区块为分析单位，为老龄化社会提供可持续经济发展路径？
AI.motivation: 传统经济学分为宏观和微观，但缺乏处理实际行政服务和社区生活基本单位（标准区块）的中观经济学理论，这一理论空白对老龄化社会的可持续发展至关重要
AI.theoretical_framework: 中观经济学框架、标准区块比较法、财富保留理论、SBCM财政乘数理论、扭曲效应和漏出效应（稻草效应）
AI.method: 标准区块比较法应用于经济理论，数学建模证明财富保留最大化优于GDP最大化，定义SBCM财政乘数并分析扭曲效应
AI.findings: 1. 老龄化社会唯一可持续路径是最大化财富保留而非GDP；2. 高预算公共工程因高扭曲度常导致负经济效应（漏出效应）；3. SBCM财政乘数揭示了政策效果的实际机制
AI.theory_contributions: 填补中观经济学理论空白，建立标准区块分析框架，提出财富保留作为可持续发展核心指标，发展SBCM财政乘数理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为老龄化社会提供政策制定框架，帮助识别和避免低效公共支出，优化资源配置以实现可持续社区发展

reference: KDI School of Pub Policy & Management Paper No. DS25-09
title: Do Longer Surveys Pay Off? Experimental Evidence on Agricultural Module Design in Kenya
affiliations: World Bank,  and KDI School of Public Policy and Management

detail.title: Do Longer Surveys Pay Off? Experimental Evidence on Agricultural Module Design in Kenya

publicationDetails.detailsText: KDI School of Pub Policy & Management Paper No. DS25-09
publicationDetails.journalName: KDI School of Public Policy & Management Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Multi-topic household surveys in low-and middle-income countries devote substantial space to agricultural modules that are costly to field and place heavy cognitive demands on respondents. Yet there is little experimental evidence on whether highly detailed, plotlevel designs actually deliver better data than simpler alternatives. We implement a randomized measurement experiment with roughly 400 smallholder households in Kenya, comparing a standard plot-by-crop module-which repeats production and input questions for each crop on each plot-to a crop-by-crop module that elicits the same information with less repetition. Random assignment generates exogenous variation in response burden: interview durations are similar for farmers with one plot but substantially longer under the plot-by-crop module for multi-plot farmers. Despite the increase in survey time, we find only modest effects on measured outcomes. Input adoption on the extensive margin is virtually identical between modules; on the intensive margin, we detect a modest increase in reported seed quantities under the plot-by-crop module, but no systematic differences in fertilizer use, input expenditures, or harvest amount. Heterogeneity by number of plots and by gender shows at most weak patterns and does not overturn the main results. Our findings suggest that shorter crop-by-crop modules can reduce interview time without compromising the key agricultural indicators used in research and policy analysis.

AI.tldr: 在肯尼亚对约400户小农户进行的随机测量实验发现，相比传统的"地块-作物"详细调查模块（对每个地块的每种作物重复询问生产和投入问题），"作物-作物"简化模块（减少重复询问）能显著缩短访谈时间，但对测量结果影响有限。简化模块在保持关键农业指标准确性的同时，能有效降低调查成本。
AI.research_question: 在低收入和中等收入国家的多主题家庭调查中，高度详细的地块级农业调查模块是否真的比更简单的替代方案提供更好的数据？
AI.motivation: 当前农业调查模块成本高昂、对受访者认知要求高，但缺乏实验证据证明详细设计是否确实优于简化方案。需要评估调查设计的效率与数据质量之间的权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于测量误差理论和认知负担理论，探讨调查设计复杂性对数据质量的影响。假设更详细的调查可能减少测量误差，但过高的认知负担可能导致数据质量下降。
AI.method: 在肯尼亚对约400户小农户进行随机测量实验，比较两种调查模块：1) 标准"地块-作物"模块（对每个地块的每种作物重复询问）；2) "作物-作物"简化模块（减少重复询问）。随机分配产生外生变异，测量访谈时长和报告结果差异。
AI.findings: 1) 访谈时长：单地块农户差异不大，但多地块农户在"地块-作物"模块下访谈时间显著更长；2) 测量结果：两种模块在投入采纳（广泛边际）上几乎相同；在集约边际上，"地块-作物"模块报告的种子数量略有增加，但在肥料使用、投入支出和收获量上无系统性差异；3) 异质性：地块数量和性别差异的影响微弱，不影响主要结论。
AI.theory_contributions: 为调查设计中的认知负担-数据质量权衡提供了实验证据，挑战了"越详细越好"的传统假设，支持在保持数据质量的前提下简化调查设计的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究人员提供了实证依据：采用更短的"作物-作物"模块可以显著减少访谈时间（特别是对多地块农户），同时不损害关键农业指标的质量，从而降低调查成本并减轻受访者负担。

title: Born Different: Entrepreneurship through Inventor Mobility, Innovation, and Growth
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta and Auburn University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Born Different: Entrepreneurship through Inventor Mobility, Innovation, and Growth
detail.abstract: Large productivity differences across firms reflect substantial ex-ante heterogeneity at entry, yet the origins of this heterogeneity remain poorly understood. This paper shows that innovating spinouts--firms formed by inventors leaving incumbent innovators--are a key endogenous source of high-growth entrepreneurship and aggregate productivity growth. Using inventor mobility in patent data, we document that spinouts systematically outperform other entrants throughout their life cycle, their performance is strongly linked to parent-firm technological strength, and their formation temporarily depresses parent-firm innovation. We develop a Schumpeterian growth model that endogenizes spinout formation and the fundamental tradeoff between knowledge diffusion, creative destruction, and appropriability. Closely disciplined by rich microlevel data, the model implies that spinouts account for a disproportionate share of high-growth firms and nearly forty percent of aggregate productivity growth, but that inventor departures also impose sizable costs on incumbents, generating a fundamental policy tradeoff. Policy counterfactuals show that relaxing non-compete restrictions raises aggregate growth and welfare and amplifies the effectiveness of entry subsidies.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究发现，由发明家离开现有创新企业创建的创新性衍生企业是高质量创业和总体生产率增长的关键内生来源。这些衍生企业在整个生命周期中表现优于其他新创企业，其绩效与母公司的技术实力密切相关，但衍生企业的形成会暂时抑制母公司的创新。模型分析显示，衍生企业贡献了近40%的总体生产率增长，但也给现有企业带来显著成本，形成了知识扩散、创造性破坏和专有性之间的基本政策权衡。
AI.research_question: 创新性衍生企业（由发明家离开现有创新企业创建的企业）如何影响高质量创业、企业绩效和总体生产率增长？衍生企业的形成对母公司和整体经济产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 企业间存在巨大的生产率差异反映了进入时的异质性，但这种异质性的起源尚不清楚。理解高质量创业的来源及其对经济增长的影响具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 熊彼特增长模型，内生化了衍生企业的形成，并分析了知识扩散、创造性破坏和专有性之间的基本权衡关系。
AI.method: 使用专利数据中的发明家流动信息进行实证分析，记录衍生企业的表现特征；开发并校准熊彼特增长模型，结合丰富的微观数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. 衍生企业在其整个生命周期中系统性地优于其他新创企业；2. 衍生企业的绩效与母公司技术实力密切相关；3. 衍生企业的形成会暂时抑制母公司的创新；4. 衍生企业贡献了不成比例的高增长企业份额和近40%的总体生产率增长；5. 发明家离职给现有企业带来显著成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将衍生企业形成内生化到熊彼特增长模型中；2. 阐明了知识扩散、创造性破坏和专有性之间的基本权衡；3. 为理解高质量创业的内生来源提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 揭示了衍生企业在经济增长中的重要作用；2. 提供了政策权衡的实证依据：放松竞业限制能提高总体增长和福利，并增强进入补贴的有效性；3. 为创业政策和创新政策设计提供了参考。

title: Lenders' Expectations and Sovereign Debt Crises Contagion
affiliations: Universidad Torcuato di Tella

detail.title: Lenders' Expectations and Sovereign Debt Crises Contagion
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the role of lenders expectation in the propagation of the Greek crisis to other Eurozone periphery countries (i.e., Italy, Spain, Ireland, and Portugal). Using data from the Consensus Economics survey, I classify lenders by their GDP growth forecast precision before the crisis. During the crisis, less precise lenders adjusted their GDP growth and sovereign bond yield forecast against the rest of the Eurozone periphery relatively more than their more precise counterparts. Consequently, less precise lenders also shifted their portfolios away from the Eurozone periphery countries relatively more. In line with a model where some lenders rely on broad categories, such as the Eurozone periphery, the less precise lenders display a stronger GDP growth forecast correlation between Greece and other Eurozone periphery countries, driving these empirical results. By incorporating this mechanism into a two-country sovereign default model, I quantify that less precise lenders might have reduced Italian bond prices by almost 15 percent more than Bayesian lenders.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了贷款人预期在希腊危机向其他欧元区外围国家传播中的作用。研究发现，危机前预测精度较低的贷款人在危机期间对欧元区外围国家的GDP增长和主权债券收益率预测调整更大，并相应减少了这些国家的投资组合配置。这种基于"欧元区外围"宽泛分类的预期机制可能使意大利债券价格比贝叶斯贷款人模型下多下跌近15%。
AI.research_question: 贷款人预期在希腊危机向其他欧元区外围国家（意大利、西班牙、爱尔兰、葡萄牙）传播中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 理解金融危机如何在国际间传播，特别是欧元区主权债务危机期间，希腊危机如何影响其他欧元区外围国家。研究关注贷款人预期在这一传播机制中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于分类思维的预期形成理论（贷款人依赖宽泛类别如"欧元区外围"进行预测），以及两国外债违约模型。
AI.method: 使用共识经济学调查数据，根据危机前GDP增长预测精度对贷款人进行分类，分析危机期间不同精度贷款人的预测调整和投资组合变化。
AI.findings: 1. 危机前预测精度较低的贷款人在危机期间对欧元区外围国家的GDP增长和主权债券收益率预测调整更大；2. 这些贷款人也相应减少了在欧元区外围国家的投资组合配置；3. 低精度贷款人对希腊和其他欧元区外围国家的GDP增长预测相关性更强；4. 模型量化显示，这种机制可能使意大利债券价格比贝叶斯贷款人模型下多下跌近15%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了基于分类思维的预期形成理论在金融危机传播中的实证证据；2. 将行为金融学的分类思维纳入主权债务危机分析框架；3. 量化了非理性预期对资产价格的实质性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者理解危机传播机制提供新视角；2. 帮助市场参与者识别基于过度简化分类的预期风险；3. 对金融监管和危机管理具有启示意义。

title: Lives Saved by Authorizing Safer Nicotine Products: Mortality, Economic Benefits, and a Comparative-Risk Framework

detail.title: Lives Saved by Authorizing Safer Nicotine Products: Mortality, Economic Benefits, and a Comparative-Risk Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I received general support from my main affiliation (International Center for Law and Economics). No funder influenced the study
declarations.funderStatement: ICLE funded my research under general grant support.

detail.abstract: Background: Cigarette smoking remains the leading preventable cause of premature mortality in the United States. Smoke-free nicotine products substantially reduce toxicant exposure compared with combustible cigarettes but remain highly restricted under U.S. premarket authorization rules, despite widespread legal availability in the European Union and United Kingdom. Objective: To estimate the mortality and economic impacts of authorizing low-risk nicotine products already accepted in comparable jurisdictions, with and without risk-proportionate public-health communication. Methods: Using established comparative-risk and state-transition frameworks, I model smokingattributable mortality under three scenarios: status quo; authorization of smoke-free nicotine products; and authorization combined with accurate relative-risk communication. Analyses are conducted at national, state (Pennsylvania), and county (Montgomery County, Pennsylvania) levels over 10-and 20-year horizons, with extensive sensitivity analyses across conservative and optimistic risk assumptions. Results: Under central estimates (vaping ≈5% and oral nicotine pouches ≈2% of smoking risk), authorization alone averts approximately 115,000 premature deaths nationally over ten years; authorization combined with communication averts approximately 245,000. Results remain robust under conservative assumptions. Avoided mortality is associated with substantial productivity preservation and reduced health-care expenditures. Conclusions: Treating smoke-free nicotine products as equivalent to cigarettes in regulatory practice imposes avoidable population-health and economic costs. Aligning authorization and communication with comparative-risk evidence represents a high-impact opportunity for reducing smoking-related harm.

AI.tldr: 该研究估计，如果美国授权已在欧盟和英国合法使用的低风险尼古丁产品，并配合风险比例沟通策略，可在10年内避免约24.5万例过早死亡，带来显著的健康和经济收益。
AI.research_question: 授权已在可比司法管辖区接受的低风险尼古丁产品（配合或不配合风险比例公共卫生沟通）对美国人口死亡率和经济会产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 吸烟仍是美国可预防过早死亡的主要原因。无烟尼古丁产品相比可燃卷烟显著减少有毒物质暴露，但在美国上市前授权规则下仍受严格限制，尽管在欧盟和英国已广泛合法使用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比较风险评估框架和状态转移模型框架，用于模拟不同政策情景下的吸烟相关死亡率。
AI.method: 使用已建立的比较风险和状态转移框架，模拟三种情景下的吸烟相关死亡率：现状、授权无烟尼古丁产品、授权加准确相对风险沟通。分析在国家、州（宾夕法尼亚州）和县（蒙哥马利县）层面进行，时间跨度为10年和20年，并对保守和乐观风险假设进行广泛敏感性分析。
AI.findings: 在中心估计下（电子烟风险约5%，口服尼古丁袋约2%），仅授权可在10年内避免约11.5万例过早死亡；授权加沟通可避免约24.5万例。结果在保守假设下保持稳健。避免的死亡率与显著的生产力保持和医疗支出减少相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了基于比较风险评估框架的政策影响分析模型，展示了如何将风险评估转化为具体的公共卫生和经济影响预测。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体数据支持：调整无烟尼古丁产品的监管实践，使其与比较风险证据一致，是减少吸烟相关危害的高影响力机会。研究结果可用于指导监管决策和公共卫生沟通策略。

title: Involvement of the Surrounding Environment as a Strategy to Strengthen the Effectiveness of Entrepreneurial Activities: A Study of the Brochick Spicy Chicken Business on Antang Raya Street, Makassar City
affiliations: Universitas Negeri Makassar

detail.title: Involvement of the Surrounding Environment as a Strategy to Strengthen the Effectiveness of Entrepreneurial Activities: A Study of the Brochick Spicy Chicken Business on Antang Raya Street, Makassar City
detail.abstract: This article aims to analyze how the surrounding environment can be involved in increasing the effectiveness of the Brochiick Fried Chicken (Ayam Geprek Brochiick) business. The study was conducted descriptively and analytically using data obtained through environmental observations, interviews with fried chicken business owners, and documentation of business operational activities. The analysis focused on mapping environmental potential, involvement of the surrounding community, support from local facilities, and the behavior of consumers living in the business area. The analysis results indicate that the surrounding environment plays a significant role in improving business sustainability, particularly through partnerships with residents, utilization of local resources, and menu adaptations to local consumer preferences. The findings also revealed that factors such as road access and proximity to densely populated residential areas and student boarding houses are key supporting variables. However, challenges arise from similar competition and fluctuations in purchasing power. The article's conclusion confirms that the Brochiick Fried Chicken (Ayam Geprek Brochiick) business has a strong opportunity to grow if it can strategically integrate the potential of the surrounding environment through collaboration, product innovation, and strengthening the community-based business ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了环境因素如何提升Brochiick炸鸡（Ayam Geprek Brochiick）业务的效益，发现周边环境通过居民合作、本地资源利用和菜单本地化对业务可持续性有显著影响，同时指出道路通达性、人口密集区和学生宿舍邻近性是关键支持因素，但也面临竞争和购买力波动的挑战。
AI.research_question: 周边环境如何参与并提高Brochiick炸鸡（Ayam Geprek Brochiick）业务的有效性？
AI.motivation: 分析环境因素对小型餐饮业务成功的影响，探索如何利用周边环境资源提升业务可持续性和竞争力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境-业务互动理论，社区参与理论，资源基础观，消费者行为理论。
AI.method: 描述性和分析性研究，通过环境观察、与炸鸡业务所有者的访谈以及业务运营活动文档收集数据。
AI.findings: 1. 周边环境对业务可持续性有显著影响；2. 居民合作、本地资源利用和菜单本地化是关键机制；3. 道路通达性、人口密集区和学生宿舍邻近性是重要支持因素；4. 面临相似竞争和购买力波动的挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了环境因素对小型餐饮业务影响的理论理解；2. 提出了环境-业务整合的战略框架；3. 丰富了社区参与和本地资源利用的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为Brochiick炸鸡业务提供具体的环境整合策略；2. 为类似餐饮业务提供可操作的环境优化建议；3. 强调合作、创新和社区生态系统建设的重要性。

title: A Neural-Statistical Hybrid Model for Value at Risk and Expectile Forecast with an Application of Cryptocurrencies
affiliations: Independent, The University of Sydney and The University of Sydney

detail.title: A Neural-Statistical Hybrid Model for Value at Risk and Expectile Forecast with an Application of Cryptocurrencies
detail.abstract: After J.P Morgan introduced the RickMetrics, Value at Risk (VaR) has been widely used in mid-1990. Later in the early 2000s, expectile began to be applied in risk management for its ability to capture tail dynamics more effectively than quantiles. This paper estimates VaR and Expectile using a hybrid approach that integrates feedforward neural networks (FNN) with statistical models, including Conditional autoregressive VaR (CAViaR) model and Realized Conditional Autoregressive Expectile (CARE) model, to enhance forecasting of quantile and expectile volatility in financial markets. Both the CAViaR and CARE models use a proxy parametric approach with the asymmetric Laplace and asymmetric Gaussian distributions. To adopt this concept to the hybrid model, their corresponding negative log-likelihoods are used as loss functions to train a neural network for quantile and expectile prediction. We provide two ways of incorporating lagged forecast information into the statistical component of the resulting hybrid model, including a cross-lagged function or self-lagged function. We compare the hybrid model against pure FNN and pure statistical models through case studies of Bitcoin and Gold data, and select the best-performing model for each quantile and expectile level. Forecasts of quantiles and expectiles using the best model at each level demonstrate strong accuracy to the target data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合前馈神经网络(FNN)与统计模型(CAViaR和CARE)的混合方法，用于预测金融市场中的VaR和期望分位数，在比特币和黄金数据上验证了其优于纯FNN和纯统计模型的性能。
AI.research_question: 如何通过结合前馈神经网络与统计模型(CAViaR和CARE)来更准确地预测金融市场中的VaR和期望分位数？
AI.motivation: VaR在1990年代中期被广泛使用，但期望分位数在2000年代初期因其能更有效地捕捉尾部动态而开始在风险管理中应用。需要开发更准确的预测方法来改进金融风险度量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于条件自回归VaR(CAViaR)模型和实现条件自回归期望分位数(CARE)模型，使用非对称拉普拉斯分布和非对称高斯分布的代理参数方法。
AI.method: 混合方法：结合前馈神经网络(FNN)与CAViaR和CARE统计模型，使用相应的负对数似然作为损失函数训练神经网络。提供了两种将滞后预测信息纳入统计组件的方法：交叉滞后函数或自滞后函数。
AI.findings: 混合模型在比特币和黄金数据上优于纯FNN和纯统计模型；为每个分位数和期望分位数水平选择了最佳模型；最佳模型在各水平上的预测显示出对目标数据的强准确性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合神经网络与统计模型的混合框架；发展了两种将滞后信息纳入统计组件的方法；扩展了CAViaR和CARE模型在神经网络环境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融风险管理提供了更准确的VaR和期望分位数预测工具；在比特币和黄金等资产上验证了方法的有效性；为从业者提供了实用的风险度量改进方案。

title: Consumers Awareness towards their Rights and Responsibilities –A Legal Perspective

detail.title: Consumers Awareness towards their Rights and Responsibilities –A Legal Perspective
