title: Patent System and Public Health in India

detail.title: Patent System and Public Health in India

publicationDetails.detailsText: in Manjit Singh and Ranjit Singh (eds.) Law and Medicine (Pacific Books International, New Delhi 2025) pp. 124-135.

detail.abstract: This chapter explores the relationship between India's patent system and public health. As the "Pharmacy of the World," India plays a crucial role in supplying affordable generic medicines worldwide. The discussion shows how patent law must balance innovation with the right to health by ensuring access to essential medicines. It also examines how constitutional values, judicial rulings, and legal safeguards shape a system that seeks fairness while promoting progress, highlighting India's efforts to address public health concerns through its patent regime.

AI.tldr: 印度专利制度与公共卫生的关系：作为"世界药房"，印度通过平衡专利保护与药品可及性，在保障创新激励的同时确保基本药物获取，体现了宪法价值、司法裁决和法律保障的综合作用。
AI.research_question: 印度专利制度如何平衡创新激励与公共卫生需求，特别是在确保基本药物可及性方面？
AI.motivation: 印度作为全球主要的仿制药供应国（"世界药房"），其专利制度对全球公共卫生具有重要影响，需要研究如何平衡专利保护与药品可及性之间的矛盾。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识产权与公共卫生的平衡理论、宪法价值与基本权利理论、专利制度的公共利益考量理论。
AI.method: 法律文本分析、司法判例研究、制度比较分析、政策效果评估。
AI.findings: 印度专利制度通过宪法价值指导、司法裁决干预和法律保障机制，成功构建了平衡创新激励与公共卫生需求的框架，确保了基本药物的可及性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了专利制度与公共卫生平衡的综合分析框架，强调了宪法价值在知识产权制度中的指导作用，丰富了发展中国家知识产权政策理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他国家设计平衡创新与公共卫生的专利制度提供参考，为国际知识产权谈判提供印度经验，为公共卫生政策制定者提供法律工具。

title: Social Purpose REIT

detail.title: Social Purpose REIT
detail.abstract: The United States grapples with a severe housing affordability crisis, often attributed to restrictive zoning laws, speculative private equity investment, and policy deficiencies. Each of these factors contributes to the housing shortage, but addressing any single factor in isolation is insufficient to resolve the underlying issue. A holistic solution requires increasing housing availability across the entire affordability spectrum through both the production of new units and the preservation of existing affordable housing. This article argues the misalignment of interests among key local stakeholders-residents, community organizations, and investors-is the fundamental cause of the housing crisis. Realignment requires a transformation of adversarial relationships into cooperative relationships. True cooperation is only possible when all parties share in both the risks and rewards of housing development and preservation. Corporate and private law, with deep experience in structuring complex deals, offer a viable mechanism for achieving this alignment. Using private ordering is different from the consensus approach, which centers public policy as the mechanism for enforcing housing policy. This paper proposes an innovative application of a familiar structure: the Social Purpose Real Estate Investment Trust (SPREIT). Altering the traditional REIT balances the interests of commercially motivated investors, necessary to achieve sufficient scale with responsive enforcement of public good, such as affordability and broad-based ownership. Through effective balancing, this proposed structure offers an immediately scalable solution to the housing affordability crisis. Over twenty years, the SPREIT would create and preserve 69,188 units of housing, 22,866 of which would be affordable, and provide up to $254 million in wealth for residents in a single city.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用社会目的房地产投资信托基金（SPREIT）作为解决美国住房可负担性危机的创新方案，通过平衡商业投资者与公共利益，在20年内可为单个城市创造和保留69,188套住房，其中22,866套为可负担住房。
AI.research_question: 如何通过利益相关者利益重新调整来解决美国住房可负担性危机？
AI.motivation: 美国面临严重的住房可负担性危机，传统方法如修改分区法、限制私募股权投资或政策调整都未能根本解决问题，需要系统性解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利益相关者理论、私人秩序理论、公私合作框架，以及房地产投资信托基金（REIT）的法律和金融结构。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，提出创新的社会目的房地产投资信托基金（SPREIT）结构设计，结合定量预测模型（20年影响评估）。
AI.findings: SPREIT能够平衡商业投资者利益与公共利益（可负担性和广泛所有权），在单个城市20年内可创造和保留69,188套住房，其中22,866套为可负担住房，并为居民创造高达2.54亿美元的财富。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将利益相关者错位理论应用于住房危机分析；2）提出私人秩序作为共识方法的替代方案；3）创新性地将传统REIT结构改造为社会目的工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供可立即扩展的住房危机解决方案；2）为地方政府提供具体的政策工具；3）为投资者创造参与社会公益的投资机会；4）为居民提供住房所有权和财富积累途径。

title: Seventy Professors, Zero Rebuttals in a Hungarian Medical University Case
affiliations: Semmelweis University

detail.title: Seventy Professors, Zero Rebuttals in a Hungarian Medical University Case

declarations.declarationOfInterest: have no personal, financial, or institutional conflicts of interest related to this study. All analysis is based on publicly accessible documents, official correspondence, digital analytics, and statutory materials. No external party influenced the research design, conclusions, or publication process.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, clinical interaction, or interventions requiring institutional review board approval. All materials analyzed consist of publicly accessible documents, official correspondence, anonymized digital analytics, and statutory sources. No personal or sensitive data were collected, processed, or disclosed beyond what is legally accessible under GDPR-compliant publication practices. Therefore, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently by the author without financial support from any university, institution, governmental body, or private organization. All publication, documentation, and data-collection activities were self-funded.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: No clinical trials were conducted in this research. Not applicable.

detail.abstract:
This article presents updated digital analytic evidence of institutional awareness and silence in a whistleblower case from Hungarian medical education. It supplements earlier case-study work on administrative obstruction at Semmelweis University and the role of the Commissioner for Fundamental Rights. It follows an initial institutional-awareness paper that relied mainly on first-wave analytics from midsummer 2025. Here, second-wave data from late 2025—weekly
ResearchGate statistics, SSRN distribution metrics, and ORCID indexing—are used to show how university officials and external oversight regulators continued to monitor detailed whistleblower case studies while taking no publicly documented corrective action.
Between August 2 and November 25, 2025, publications on administrative obstruction, educational rights, and cross-border oversight received hundreds of reads from Hungary. More than seventy of these reads came from professor-level accounts affiliated with Semmelweis University, alongside additional traffic from national oversight institutions and foreign
universities. Weekly analytics for late November 17 -23, 2025, show renewed, concentrated bursts of domestic readership while the university-maintained silence, the Dean’s Office demanded the removal of the studies from academic platforms, and the Ombudsman’s Directorate for Equal Treatment attempted to block further email submissions.
The article argues that such patterns of ‘awareness without review’ constitute a measurable form of institutional silence that regulators and accreditation agencies should treat as probative evidence. Digital platform metrics show that universities and regulators are not ignorant of well-documented allegations; they are choosing not to act. The Semmelweis case illustrates how scientific literacy and legal responsibility can diverge—and how whistleblowers and regulators can use digital analytics to close that gap.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过数字分析证据展示了匈牙利塞梅尔维斯大学在举报人案件中"知情但沉默"的制度行为模式，使用2025年夏季至秋季的学术平台数据追踪机构监控但无公开纠正行动的现象。
AI.research_question: 学术机构和监管机构在举报人案件中如何通过数字监控模式表现出"知情但不审查"的制度沉默行为？
AI.motivation: 补充先前关于塞梅尔维斯大学行政阻碍和基本权利专员作用的案例研究，通过第二波数字分析数据揭示机构在知情情况下选择沉默的行为模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度沉默理论、举报人保护机制、数字监控与机构责任、学术自由与行政阻碍的交叉分析框架。
AI.method: 使用第二波数字分析数据（2025年8月2日至11月25日），包括ResearchGate统计数据、SSRN分发指标和ORCID索引，追踪匈牙利国内特别是塞梅尔维斯大学及相关监管机构的阅读行为模式。
AI.findings: 1. 2025年8-11月期间，相关研究获得数百次匈牙利阅读量，其中70多次来自塞梅尔维斯大学教授账户；2. 11月17-23日出现集中的国内阅读高峰；3. 机构在持续监控的同时保持公开沉默，甚至要求删除研究并阻止进一步提交；4. 数字指标显示机构并非不知情，而是选择不采取行动。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"知情但不审查"作为可测量的制度沉默形式；2. 将数字平台指标发展为制度责任的证据工具；3. 展示了科学素养与法律责任之间的分离现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管和认证机构提供可操作的证据收集方法；2. 为举报人和监管者提供数字分析工具以缩小责任差距；3. 揭示了学术机构在知情情况下的不作为模式，推动制度改革。

title: Tokenism, Policy Elitism, and Youth Exclusion in South Africa's Global Representation- Beyond Tokenism: Rethinking Youth Representation in South Africa's Global Policy Engagements

detail.title: Tokenism, Policy Elitism, and Youth Exclusion in South Africa's Global Representation- Beyond Tokenism: Rethinking Youth Representation in South Africa's Global Policy Engagements
detail.abstract:
This paper examines the phenomenon of tokenism and elite capture in South Africa’s youth representation within global policy spaces, particularly focusing on overreliance on University of Cape Town (UCT) and other elite institution students in forums such as the United Nations and BRICS youth summits. While these students are frequently positioned as “representative” voices, their participation often reflects a narrow, urban, and privileged perspective, excluding the majority of South African youth, including high school learners, unemployed youth, and students in technical and vocational education
and training (TVET) institutions. Drawing on theories of tokenism, elite capture,and participatory governance, the paper situates these patterns within South Africa’s historical context of exclusion and symbolic representation.The study highlights the structural mechanisms that reproduce inequality in youth engagement,including institutional prestige, cultural and linguistic capital, and entrenched mentorship and networking systems that privilege university,educated youth. The analysis demonstrates how such selective inclusion distorts both national and international perceptions of South African
youth priorities, leading to policy recommendations that fail to address the realities of the majority. Exclusion of marginalized youth not only undermines policy relevance but also risks fostering political disillusionment, civic apathy, and a reinforcement of socioeconomic inequities.
In response, the paper proposes a reimagined model of youth engagement that emphasizes inclusivity,participatory agency, and early involvement. Key strategies include integrating high school learners into structured civic forums, implementing
formal quotas for non,university youth in international delegations, leveraging digital platforms to broaden access, and providing capacity,building programs to empower marginalized youth to engage meaningfully. Global models, such as youth assemblies, advisory panels, and participatory budgeting initiatives, are examined as adaptable frameworks to South African contexts.
Ultimately, this paper argues that tokenism and elite capture in youth representation are not merely symbolic issues but systemic barriers to democratic inclusion. By expanding youth engagement beyond elite circles and ensuring that policies reflect the lived experiences of the majority, South Africa can strengthen democratic legitimacy, enhance policy effectiveness, and cultivate a generation of empowered, civically engaged youth. The findings underscore that meaningful inclusion requires moving beyond rhetoric toward participatory structures that recognize all youth as agents of change,rather than
reserving influence for a select few.

AI.tldr: 本文研究南非青年在全球政策空间中的象征性代表和精英俘获现象，重点关注开普敦大学等精英院校学生在联合国和BRICS青年峰会等论坛中的过度代表问题。这些"代表性"声音往往反映狭隘的城市特权视角，排除了大多数南非青年。文章提出更具包容性的青年参与模式，强调参与式代理和早期介入。
AI.research_question: 南非青年在全球政策空间中的代表性问题：为什么开普敦大学等精英院校学生被过度代表？这种象征性代表和精英俘获如何影响政策制定，以及如何建立更具包容性的青年参与机制？
AI.motivation: 南非青年在全球政策论坛中的代表存在严重不平等，精英院校学生被过度代表，而大多数青年（高中生、失业青年、职业技术教育学生）被排除在外。这种象征性代表不仅扭曲了国内外对南非青年优先事项的认知，还导致政策建议脱离实际，可能引发政治幻灭和公民冷漠。
AI.theoretical_framework: 象征主义理论、精英俘获理论、参与式治理理论，结合南非历史上的排斥和象征性代表背景。
AI.method: 基于理论框架的批判性分析，结合南非历史背景和结构性机制分析，考察全球青年参与模式在南非的适用性。
AI.findings: 1. 南非青年全球代表存在严重的象征性代表和精英俘获问题；2. 结构性机制（机构声望、文化语言资本、导师网络）加剧不平等；3. 选择性包容扭曲国内外对青年优先事项的认知；4. 边缘化青年的排斥削弱政策相关性，可能导致政治幻灭。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将象征主义和精英俘获理论应用于南非青年全球代表分析；2. 揭示结构性机制如何再生产青年参与不平等；3. 提出参与式代理作为替代框架；4. 将青年代表问题置于民主包容的系统性障碍层面。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出包容性青年参与模式；2. 具体策略：整合高中生到公民论坛、为非大学青年设定国际代表团配额、利用数字平台扩大参与、提供能力建设项目；3. 借鉴全球模式（青年大会、咨询小组、参与式预算）的适应性应用；4. 强调从修辞转向实际参与结构的重要性。

title: Osmotic Trade Pressure, Authoritarian Development, and Prosperity: China-EU Relations as a Quantitative Test Case

detail.title: Osmotic Trade Pressure, Authoritarian Development, and Prosperity: China-EU Relations as a Quantitative Test Case
detail.abstract: This paper develops a quantitative model of "osmotic trade pressure" to explain how an authoritarian state can leverage international trade, foreign direct investment (FDI), and technology transfer to generate sustained gains in material prosperity without converging to Western-style liberal democracy. Building on the institutional dichotomy between inclusive and extractive regimes proposed by Acemoglu et al. (2001); Acemoglu and Robinson (2012) and the more pragmatic development approach of Collier (2007, 2010), we reinterpret China's external economic strategy as an intelligent trade framework that systematically combines (i) export advantage mechanisms, (ii) net profit repatriation controls, and (iii) rules that facilitate the transfer and localization of technology and technology-related property rights. These institutional choices generate a persistent structural incentive-an "osmotic pressure" Π T-that channels resources, knowledge, and rents from trading partners into domestic accumulation. We construct a composite index of this pressure and estimate a logistic relationship between the index and China's real GDP per capita W t. The results challenge the universal claims of the inclusive-institutions paradigm and are consistent with Collier's more context-sensitive view of state-led development.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了"渗透性贸易压力"的量化模型，解释威权国家如何利用国际贸易、FDI和技术转移实现持续经济增长而不必转向西方自由民主。基于中国案例，该模型挑战了包容性制度的普适性主张。
AI.research_question: 威权国家如何通过国际贸易、外国直接投资和技术转移实现持续经济增长而不必转向西方自由民主？
AI.motivation: 挑战Acemoglu等人提出的包容性制度普适性主张，解释中国等威权国家在未采纳西方民主制度情况下实现经济持续增长的现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合Acemoglu等人的包容性与榨取性制度二分法，以及Collier更务实的国家主导发展观，构建"渗透性贸易压力"理论框架。
AI.method: 构建"渗透性贸易压力"综合指数，并估计该指数与中国实际人均GDP之间的逻辑关系。
AI.findings: 中国的外部经济战略通过出口优势机制、净利润汇回控制和促进技术转移本地化的规则，创造了持续的结构性激励，将资源、知识和租金从贸易伙伴导向国内积累。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战包容性制度普适性范式，支持Collier更具情境敏感性的国家主导发展观，为威权国家经济增长提供新的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国等威权国家的经济发展战略提供分析框架，帮助理解国家如何通过制度设计在国际贸易中获取最大利益。

title: Ethical AI in Education: Principles, Governance, and Responsible Implementation
affiliations: University of the National Education Commission, Krakow

detail.title: Ethical AI in Education: Principles, Governance, and Responsible Implementation
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is increasingly embedded in education through learning analytics, adaptive learning systems, automated feedback, proctoring, student support chatbots, and generative AI tools, with implications for how decisions are justified and how responsibility is distributed. The paper aims to articulate domain-specific ethical AI principles for education that protect learner rights, reinforce equity, and preserve the integrity of assessment while enabling responsible innovation. A structured narrative review and normative synthesis are used to integrate AI ethics and governance guidance with AI-ineducation research, then translate these insights into implementable principles and lifecycle governance mechanisms. The analysis shows that generic AI ethics statements are insufficient without pedagogical grounding, because educational quality depends on developmental, relational, and legitimacy conditions that are not captured by technical metrics alone. The resulting framework prioritizes human-centered educational benefit, learner agency with meaningful oversight, fairness and inclusion, privacy and data minimization, transparency proportional to decision impact, safety and wellbeing protections, academic integrity by design, and accountability with remedy in high-impact uses. Ethical AI in education requires institutional governance that connects values to procurement, deployment, classroom practice, monitoring, and evaluation across the AI lifecycle. Future work should strengthen measurement frameworks and empirical evidence for safeguarded AI use in high-stakes contexts, and examine implementation capacity in procurement, training, and postdeployment monitoring.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了教育领域特定的AI伦理原则框架，强调通用AI伦理声明不足以应对教育场景，需要基于教育学基础制定可实施的伦理原则和全生命周期治理机制。
AI.research_question: 如何为教育领域制定和实施专门的AI伦理原则，以保护学习者权利、促进公平、维护评估完整性，同时支持负责任的创新？
AI.motivation: AI在教育中的应用日益广泛（学习分析、自适应学习系统、自动反馈、监考、学生支持聊天机器人、生成式AI工具），这对决策合理性和责任分配产生影响。通用AI伦理原则缺乏教育学基础，无法充分应对教育质量所依赖的发展性、关系性和合法性条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合AI伦理与治理指导原则与AI教育研究，基于教育学理论（强调教育质量的发展性、关系性和合法性维度），构建教育领域特定的AI伦理框架。
AI.method: 采用结构化叙事回顾和规范性综合方法，整合AI伦理与治理指导原则以及AI教育研究，将这些见解转化为可实施的原则和生命周期治理机制。
AI.findings: 分析表明，通用AI伦理声明缺乏教育学基础是不够的，因为教育质量依赖于发展性、关系性和合法性条件，这些无法仅通过技术指标来衡量。由此产生的框架优先考虑：以人为中心的教育效益、具有有意义监督的学习者自主权、公平与包容、隐私与数据最小化、与决策影响相称的透明度、安全与福祉保护、设计中的学术诚信，以及高影响使用中的问责与补救。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了教育领域特定的AI伦理理论框架，强调教育学基础对AI伦理的重要性，将AI伦理原则与教育质量的发展性、关系性和合法性维度相结合。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可实施的AI伦理原则和全生命周期治理机制，指导教育机构将价值观连接到采购、部署、课堂实践、监控和评估等各个环节。为高利害情境下的AI使用提供了测量框架和实证证据的改进方向，并考察了采购、培训和部署后监控等实施能力。

title: Embracing the "Village" or Going-it-Alone? Understanding the Entrepreneurial Ecosystem Mindset
affiliations: University of Tennessee at Chattanooga

detail.title: Embracing the "Village" or Going-it-Alone? Understanding the Entrepreneurial Ecosystem Mindset
detail.abstract: Entrepreneurs differ in their willingness to adopt an ecosystem approach to venture creation and development. However, it is not clear what explains the systematic differences in entrepreneurs' involvement in their entrepreneurial ecosystems. To address this void in our understanding of entrepreneurial ecosystems, this chapter introduces the concept of an entrepreneurial ecosystem mindset (EEM)-an orientation towards seeking and contributing resources to a local community of entrepreneurs. The characteristics and uniqueness of EEM are established and a multi-level theory is presented that explains how EEM influences entrepreneurs' ecosystem-related behaviors and how these behaviors, in turn, influence entrepreneur and ecosystem performance. The theory of EEM connects research on entrepreneurial cognition to the ecosystem level, adds clarity to the micro-foundations of entrepreneurial ecosystems, and explains why some entrepreneurs utilize their local ecosystems while others view entrepreneurship as an individual-, rather than community-oriented, activity. The theory also generates practical implications for entrepreneurs, ecosystem leaders, and individuals wanting to foster an entrepreneurial ecosystem mindset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"创业生态系统思维"概念，解释为何有些创业者采用生态系统方法而其他人将创业视为个体活动，并建立多层次理论连接个体认知与生态系统绩效。
AI.research_question: 什么解释了创业者参与创业生态系统的系统性差异？
AI.motivation: 创业者对采用生态系统方法的态度存在差异，但现有研究未能解释这些系统性差异的原因，存在理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创业生态系统思维（EEM）概念、多层次理论框架、创业认知理论与生态系统理论的连接。
AI.method: 概念开发与理论构建方法（未明确实证方法，属于理论章节）。
AI.findings: 建立了EEM的特征和独特性，提出了解释EEM如何影响创业者生态系统相关行为以及这些行为如何影响创业者和生态系统绩效的多层次理论。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将创业认知研究连接到生态系统层面；2. 澄清创业生态系统的微观基础；3. 解释创业者利用本地生态系统的差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创业者、生态系统领导者和希望培养创业生态系统思维的个人提供实践启示。

title: AI Data Centers in a NEPA Void
affiliations: Emory University School of Law

detail.title: AI Data Centers in a NEPA Void
detail.abstract: In 2025, a new White House executive order (FAST-41) and AI action plan directed federal agencies to speed up environmental review for large AI data centers by creating new National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) categorical exclusions, expanding use of a fast-track permitting program, and relying more heavily on exemptions from full review. As these federal safeguards for public input and scientific scrutiny narrowed, I show that local governments and communities began to reconstruct key procedural functions—disclosure, participation, and accountability—through transparency agreements, Community Benefits Agreements (CBAs), and other negotiated provisions. In this Policy Forum, I introduce “Shadow  NEPA” as an analytical lens for understanding how these decentralized arrangements partially rebuild NEPA-like safeguards when formal federal review is limited or bypassed. Drawing on cases from Oregon, Virginia, and Arizona, I argue that AI data center projects with more complete procedural reconstruction enjoy greater perceived legitimacy and legal-political stability than projects with thin or absent safeguards. I then propose “Shadow NEPA Plus,” which extends these practices into a digital accountability framework that integrates real-time monitoring of water and energy use and basic algorithmic transparency requirements into oversight of AI infrastructure. I conclude that policymakers should condition fast-track permitting on procedural completeness and embed digital accountability standards into sector-specific rules so that environmental decisions about AI infrastructure remain credible as development accelerates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"影子NEPA"概念，分析当联邦环境审查程序简化时，地方政府和社区如何通过透明度协议、社区利益协议等方式重建关键程序功能，并建议将数字问责标准纳入快速审批条件。
AI.research_question: 当联邦环境审查程序（NEPA）因AI数据中心快速审批政策而简化时，地方政府和社区如何重建关键程序功能（披露、参与、问责），以及这种重建如何影响项目的合法性和稳定性？
AI.motivation: 2025年白宫行政命令（FAST-41）和AI行动计划要求联邦机构加快AI数据中心的环境审查，通过创建新的NEPA分类排除、扩大快速审批程序使用、减少全面审查。这导致公众参与和科学审查的联邦保障措施被削弱，需要研究地方层面如何应对这种变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: "影子NEPA"分析框架：用于理解当正式联邦审查受限或被绕过时，分散化安排如何部分重建类似NEPA的保障措施。包括透明度协议、社区利益协议（CBAs）等协商条款。
AI.method: 案例研究法：基于俄勒冈州、弗吉尼亚州和亚利桑那州的AI数据中心项目案例进行分析。
AI.findings: 程序重建更完整的AI数据中心项目比保障措施薄弱或缺失的项目享有更高的感知合法性和法律政治稳定性。"影子NEPA"实践可以扩展为"影子NEPA Plus"，整合实时水电使用监控和基本算法透明度要求。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"影子NEPA"作为分析框架，理解环境治理中的分散化程序重建；2. 扩展为"影子NEPA Plus"，将数字问责纳入环境监管框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议政策制定者将快速审批条件与程序完整性挂钩；2. 建议将数字问责标准嵌入特定行业规则；3. 为AI基础设施环境决策提供可操作的政策建议。

title: The Unintended Consequences of Special Economic Zones on Crime
affiliations: Peking University,  and Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE) - School of Economics

detail.title: The Unintended Consequences of Special Economic Zones on Crime
detail.abstract: Can pro-growth place-based policies cause social instability? This paper uses a unique hand-collected dataset on legal cases and special economic zones (SEZs) in China to examine the impact of pro-growth place-based policies on local crime in a developing country context. Exploiting the establishment of SEZs as a quasi-natural experiment, we document that SEZs increase the local crime rate by 27.9 percent. We further show that SEZs significantly impact potential determinants of crime, including labor market conditions, public goods investment, and migration. Leveraging a novel decomposition framework, we emphasize the dominating role of migration in contributing to SEZs' effect on rising crime. Auxiliary evidence suggests that crime is likely driven by social conflicts faced by migrants. The results highlight previously overlooked unintended social consequences of place-based programs in developing countries.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用中国特殊经济区（SEZs）作为准自然实验，发现促进增长的地方政策会导致当地犯罪率上升27.9%，主要原因是移民带来的社会冲突。
AI.research_question: 促进增长的地方政策（如特殊经济区）是否会导致社会不稳定？具体而言，这些政策如何影响发展中国家的地方犯罪率？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注地方政策的经济效益，但忽视了其潜在的社会成本。在发展中国家的背景下，了解这些政策对社会稳定的影响具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于犯罪经济学理论，考虑劳动力市场条件、公共产品投资和移民等因素对犯罪率的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用中国特殊经济区（SEZs）作为准自然实验，采用手工收集的法律案件和SEZs数据集，运用分解框架分析移民等因素的贡献。
AI.findings: 1. SEZs使当地犯罪率上升27.9%；2. SEZs显著影响犯罪的潜在决定因素（劳动力市场、公共产品投资、移民）；3. 移民在SEZs对犯罪率上升的影响中起主导作用；4. 犯罪可能由移民面临的社会冲突驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了地方政策的社会外部性；2. 强调了移民在犯罪机制中的关键作用；3. 为发展经济学和犯罪经济学提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提醒政策制定者考虑地方政策的社会后果；2. 建议在实施经济区政策时加强社会融合措施；3. 为发展中国家制定更全面的发展政策提供参考。

title: Geopolitical Analysis of Energy Transition
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS) and Manila Observatory

detail.title: Geopolitical Analysis of Energy Transition
detail.abstract: The energy transition is conventionally assessed through costs, investment needs, and emissions pathways, yet delivery depends on geopolitics: whether pivotal actors have incentives, priorities, and capacities to supply system-critical components at scale. Empirical work often treats geopolitics as an exogenous risk, rather than modelling strategic interaction, non-linear delivery logics, and uncertainty in one framework. We develop a geopolitics model that integrates (i) strategic interaction using Bueno de Mesquita's preferences-salience-capability (PSC) logic, (ii) Sandler's collective-action lens by mapping seven transition pillars to aggregation technologies (summation, threshold, best-shot, weakest-link), and (iii) Monte Carlo simulation to generate distributions under uncertainty. Using a documented PSC matrix, we construct an Energy Transition Feasibility Index (ETFI) spanning renewable scale-up, grids and flexibility, nuclear, electrification, critical minerals and supply chains, trade/standards/industrial policy, and finance/de-risking. Across 10,000 simulations, feasibility is highest under coordination/clubs (median ETFI 0.664), moderate in baseline conditions (0.634), and deteriorates under fragmentation (0.544) and exportcontrols escalation (0.514). Declines are non-linear, driven by threshold gate failures in trade/standards and grids, and weakest-link vulnerabilities in minerals. Policy priorities are gate-clearing reforms and chokepoint risk reduction via diversification, substitution, recycling, and risk-sharing finance.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个整合战略互动、集体行动逻辑和不确定性的地缘政治模型，评估能源转型可行性。研究发现，协调合作情景下转型可行性最高，碎片化和出口管制升级会显著降低可行性，政策重点应关注瓶颈改革和关键节点风险降低。
AI.research_question: 如何系统评估地缘政治因素对能源转型可行性的影响？具体而言，不同地缘政治情景下能源转型的可行性如何变化？哪些关键环节最容易受到地缘政治风险的影响？
AI.motivation: 传统能源转型评估主要关注成本、投资需求和排放路径，但实际交付取决于地缘政治因素。现有研究往往将地缘政治视为外生风险，缺乏整合战略互动、非线性交付逻辑和不确定性的统一分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) Bueno de Mesquita的偏好-显著性-能力(PSC)逻辑用于分析战略互动；2) Sandler的集体行动视角，将七个转型支柱映射到四种聚合技术(求和、阈值、最佳射击、最弱链接)；3) 蒙特卡洛模拟处理不确定性。
AI.method: 开发了一个整合PSC逻辑、集体行动视角和蒙特卡洛模拟的地缘政治模型。构建能源转型可行性指数(ETFI)，涵盖可再生能源规模化、电网与灵活性、核能、电气化、关键矿产与供应链、贸易/标准/产业政策、金融/去风险等七个支柱。通过10,000次模拟生成不同情景下的可行性分布。
AI.findings: 协调/俱乐部情景下转型可行性最高(ETFI中位数0.664)，基准条件下中等(0.634)，碎片化情景下下降(0.544)，出口管制升级情景下最低(0.514)。下降是非线性的，主要由贸易/标准领域的阈值门限失效和电网问题驱动，关键矿产领域存在最弱链接脆弱性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 首次将战略互动、集体行动逻辑和不确定性整合到统一的能源转型地缘政治分析框架中；2) 开发了ETFI指数系统评估转型可行性；3) 识别了不同转型支柱的集体行动特征(阈值、最弱链接等)。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供优先行动指南：关注瓶颈改革和关键节点风险降低；2) 具体政策建议包括多元化、替代、回收和风险分担融资；3) 识别了贸易/标准和电网领域的阈值门限失效风险，以及关键矿产的最弱链接脆弱性。

title: Does Populism Cause Economic Outcomes
affiliations: Leipzig University

detail.title: Does Populism Cause Economic Outcomes
detail.abstract: Populist governance is frequently linked to economic decline while many expect it to tackle high inequality. Yet its macroeconomic and distributional consequences remain contested. Adopting a minimalist definition of populism focused on anti-elite rhetoric and stripped of inherent policy content, systematic findings of economic deterioration under populist rule present a puzzle. While the literature suggests that individual leaders matter, their average effects on growth are close to zero and highly heterogeneous. This paper reexamines the impacts of populist rule on 17 macroeconomic, distributional, and socio-political outcomes through a granular lens, providing unprecedented detail and challenging uniform claims of populist-induced harm. Using the augmented synthetic control method, permutation-based inference, and an extensive battery of robustness checks, the assumption that populism causally determines economic outcomes is called into question.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视民粹主义统治对宏观经济、分配和社会政治结果的影响，通过精细分析挑战了民粹主义必然导致经济恶化的统一论断。
AI.research_question: 民粹主义统治对宏观经济、分配和社会政治结果有何因果影响？
AI.motivation: 民粹主义常与经济衰退相关联，但人们又期望它能解决高不平等问题。然而其宏观经济和分配后果仍存在争议。现有文献显示民粹主义统治下经济恶化的系统性发现与民粹主义定义（强调反精英言论而非具体政策内容）之间存在矛盾。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用民粹主义的最小化定义，聚焦反精英言论，剥离固有的政策内容。文献表明个体领导人很重要，但他们对增长的平均效应接近零且高度异质性。
AI.method: 使用增强合成控制方法、基于置换的推断以及广泛的稳健性检验，分析民粹主义统治对17个宏观经济、分配和社会政治结果的影响。
AI.findings: 民粹主义对经济结果的因果决定假设受到质疑，挑战了民粹主义必然导致经济损害的统一论断。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过精细分析提供了前所未有的细节，挑战了关于民粹主义影响的统一论断，为民粹主义经济后果的异质性提供了理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更细致的视角，表明民粹主义统治的经济后果并非必然负面，需要考虑具体情境和领导人的异质性。

title: The Praxeological Foundations of Extended Phenotype Theory: Mises, Dawkins, and the Micro-Mechanics of Legal Evolution

detail.title: The Praxeological Foundations of Extended Phenotype Theory: Mises, Dawkins, and the Micro-Mechanics of Legal Evolution

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. No financial relationships or competing interests influenced this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study analyzed publicly available legal documents and constitutional provisions; no human subjects were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The author conducted this work independently.

detail.abstract:
In a previous paper (Lerer 2025a), I argued that Richard Dawkins and F.A. Hayek arrived, through different paths, at structurally similar solutions to the same problem: explaining complex order without invoking a designer. This paper extends that synthesis by incorporating Ludwig von Mises's praxeology. 
My argument is straightforward: Hayek explained what emerges from individual behavior but left a gap regarding why individuals adopt certain rules rather than others. Mises provides an answer: purposeful action aimed at substituting a less satisfactory state for a more satisfactory one. If legal institutions are extended phenotypes of memes competing for replication, we need to understand the adoption mechanism. That mechanism is praxeological. A norm spreads not because it serves abstract "social functions" but because concrete individuals perceive it as useful for their ends. The cui bono question receives a praxeological answer: memes benefit those who adopt them as tools for action. 
This integration has practical consequences: it explains why legal transplants fail when they ignore adoption logic, why centralized constitutional design tends to produce anomie, and why dysfunctional institutions persist when individual actors sustain them through actions that, from their perspective, make sense.

AI.tldr: 该论文将米塞斯的行为学（praxeology）整合到达尔文和哈耶克的框架中，解释复杂秩序如何在没有设计者的情况下形成，特别关注个体为何采纳特定规则而非其他规则。
AI.research_question: 如何将米塞斯的行为学整合到达尔文和哈耶克的框架中，以解释个体为何采纳特定规则而非其他规则，以及这种整合对理解制度变迁有何意义？
AI.motivation: 哈耶克解释了复杂秩序如何从个体行为中涌现，但未能充分解释个体为何采纳某些规则而非其他规则。米塞斯的行为学可以填补这一理论空白，为理解制度变迁提供更完整的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 理查德·道金斯的模因理论（文化演化） 2. F.A.哈耶克的演化认识论和自发秩序理论 3. 路德维希·冯·米塞斯的行为学（人类行为学） 4. 制度作为模因的延伸表现型
AI.method: 理论整合与概念分析：通过理论综合的方法，将米塞斯的行为学整合到达尔文和哈耶克的现有框架中，构建一个更完整的解释复杂秩序形成的理论模型。
AI.findings: 1. 规范传播不是因为服务抽象的"社会功能"，而是因为具体个体将其视为实现自身目的的有用工具 2. 法律移植失败是因为忽视了采纳逻辑 3. 中央集权的宪法设计往往导致失范 4. 功能失调的制度之所以持续存在，是因为个体行动者从自身视角看，维持这些制度的行为是有意义的
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 填补了哈耶克理论中关于个体规则采纳机制的空白 2. 将行为学整合到文化演化理论中 3. 为"谁受益"问题提供了行为学答案：模因使采纳者受益，作为行动工具 4. 建立了更完整的复杂秩序形成理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 解释法律移植失败的原因 2. 说明中央集权宪法设计的问题 3. 解释功能失调制度为何持续存在 4. 为制度设计和改革提供理论指导

title: Does Pairs Trading Strategy Effectiveness Depend on the Method, Sector, And/Or Economic Regime? Evidence from Forty-Eight Years of Daily S&P 500 Data and Three Pairs Selection Methods

detail.title: Does Pairs Trading Strategy Effectiveness Depend on the Method, Sector, And/Or Economic Regime? Evidence from Forty-Eight Years of Daily S&P 500 Data and Three Pairs Selection Methods

contentType.other: Masters in Finance (Asset Pricing) - King's College London Business School

detail.abstract: This dissertation tests the hypothesis equity pairs trading strategy effectiveness is contingent on the prevailing macroeconomic regime, sector, and selection method. Using forty-eight years of the S&P 500, I find no single method wins across all conditions: performance is highly regime and sector specific. For example, Method 3 achieves the highest overall win-rate (80.95%) during Expansion in a long Communication Services and short in Industrials trade generating an average alpha of 7.90% above the S&P 500 over identical holding periods. Peak economic regimes generated the lowest win-rate and returns in all three methods. Moreover, while regime transitions of any kind are challenging for pairs trading, Method 1 leads during transitions in an Expansion to Recovery regime transition with an average 2.00% alpha. Method 2 generated the lowest average return (-35.00%) in Expansion to Contraction regime transitions but achieved an average 10.00% return (the highest achieved of all methods) on a long Energy and short Real Estate trade during Expansion. By linking pair-selection method, sector exposure, and regime timing, this study develops a regime-aware framework for systematic strategy deployment. Performance is benchmarked against the S&P 500 using trade-level P&L, Sharpe and Sortino ratios, and win-rates segmented by regime, transition, and sector. The findings provide fund managers with an actionable roadmap for dynamically allocating capital and identifying when pairs trading can deliver alpha or when passive exposure is more efficient.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验了股票配对交易策略的有效性取决于宏观经济周期、行业和选择方法的假设。研究发现没有单一方法在所有条件下都有效，表现高度依赖于经济周期和行业。研究开发了一个基于经济周期的框架，为基金经理提供了动态配置资本和识别配对交易机会的路线图。
AI.research_question: 股票配对交易策略的有效性是否取决于宏观经济周期、行业和选择方法？
AI.motivation: 现有研究可能假设配对交易策略在不同条件下都有效，但实际表现可能高度依赖于宏观经济环境、行业特征和选择方法。需要理解这些因素如何影响策略表现，以提供更有效的投资指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宏观经济周期理论、配对交易理论和行业轮动理论，构建了一个包含经济周期、行业暴露和选择方法的多维度分析框架。
AI.method: 使用48年的标普500数据，分析三种不同的配对选择方法在不同宏观经济周期（扩张、收缩、复苏、峰值）和行业组合下的表现。使用交易层面的盈亏、夏普比率、索提诺比率和胜率等指标，并与标普500进行基准比较。
AI.findings: 1. 没有单一方法在所有条件下都有效，表现高度依赖于经济周期和行业；2. 方法3在扩张期通信服务行业做多、工业行业做空的交易中表现最佳，胜率达80.95%，平均alpha为7.90%；3. 经济峰值期所有方法的胜率和回报都最低；4. 经济周期转换期对配对交易具有挑战性，但方法1在扩张到复苏的转换中表现最好；5. 方法2在扩张到收缩的转换中表现最差，但在扩张期能源做多、房地产做空的交易中获得了10.00%的最高回报。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了一个基于经济周期的配对交易分析框架；2. 揭示了配对交易表现对宏观经济周期、行业和选择方法的依赖性；3. 扩展了配对交易理论，强调了情境因素的重要性；4. 为系统性策略部署提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为基金经理提供了动态配置资本的行动路线图；2. 帮助识别何时配对交易能产生alpha，何时被动投资更有效；3. 提供了具体的行业和周期组合建议；4. 开发了可操作的系统性策略部署框架。

title: The Citation Triage Rule
affiliations: Red Analytics

detail.title: The Citation Triage Rule

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this work.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Citations are commonly treated as evidence that a claim has already been validated. Their practical function is to allow readers to rely on prior work without reconstructing the underlying analysis. This expectation is not naive; it reflects a reasonable division of labor shaped by peer review, editorial oversight, and professional norms surrounding publication. In practice, it is unclear to the reader who is responsible for checking whether a citation supports the claim. Citations signal credibility, but they do not guarantee that the referenced work demonstrates what is being asserted. The resulting verification risk falls asymmetrically on downstream decisionmakers, who implicitly inherit the burden of validation at the point of use. This paper introduces the Citation Triage Rule (CTR), a cost-aware governance principle that formalizes when citation inspection is warranted and how verification efforts may be reasonably terminated. CTR does not challenge institutional review or impute intent; it addresses a blind spot created by reasonable assumptions about how evidence is handled. CTR offers a practical framework for managing risk without requiring exhaustive verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"引文分类规则"(CTR)，这是一个成本感知的治理原则，用于规范何时需要检查引文以及如何合理终止验证工作，以解决引文验证风险不对称地落在下游决策者身上的问题。
AI.research_question: 在学术实践中，当引文被用作证据支持时，谁应该负责检查引文是否真正支持所声称的内容？如何建立一个实用的框架来管理引文验证风险，而不需要穷尽验证？
AI.motivation: 引文通常被视为证据，表明某个主张已经得到验证，但实际上引文只传递可信度，并不能保证被引用的工作确实证明了所声称的内容。这种验证风险不对称地落在下游决策者身上，他们隐含地承担了验证负担。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于学术分工理论、引文实践的社会规范、以及风险管理和成本效益分析框架，特别是关注引文验证中的责任分配和风险承担问题。
AI.method: 概念分析和理论构建方法，通过分析引文实践中的制度安排和社会规范，提出一个形式化的治理原则框架。
AI.findings: 引文验证存在制度性盲点，下游决策者承担了不成比例的验证风险。引文分类规则(CTR)提供了一个实用的框架，用于确定何时需要检查引文以及如何合理终止验证工作。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 形式化了引文验证责任分配的理论框架；2) 提出了"引文分类规则"这一成本感知治理原则；3) 揭示了学术实践中引文验证的制度性盲点。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为研究人员、编辑和决策者提供了一个实用的引文验证管理框架；2) 帮助降低下游决策者的验证负担；3) 在不挑战现有审稿制度的前提下改善证据处理实践。

title: Reconciling Classical Rationality and Behavioral Economics: A Hybrid Framework for Microeconomic Theory

detail.title: Reconciling Classical Rationality and Behavioral Economics: A Hybrid Framework for Microeconomic Theory

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known personal, financial, or professional conflicts of interest that could have influenced the research presented in this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, or experimental interventions. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

keywords: Information Processing Constraints; Adaptive Economic Behavior

detail.abstract:
Classical microeconomic theory, grounded in assumptions of perfect rationality and information, often fails to capture actual human decision-making processes constrained by cognitive limitations and contextual factors. This work proposes a hybrid decision-making framework integrating classical optimization with bounded rationality, where agents adaptively filter information and employ satisficing heuristics shaped by social norms and institutional environments. The model introduces a dual-layer structure: an outer cognitive-perceptual filter that constructs perceived feasible sets and an inner optimization layer operating within these bounded domains. Incorporating social preferences such as fairness and reciprocity, as well as dynamic adaptation mechanisms, this approach reconciles normative rational choice principles with empirical behavioral pat-
terns. The framework enhances predictive accuracy across diverse economic contexts by accounting for selective attention, heuristic biases, and evolving aspiration levels. It also informs policy design by emphasizing the importance of both material incentives and perceptual salience in shaping responses. This integrative perspective offers a coherent foundation for extending microeconomic analysis into institutional, macroeconomic, and distributional domains, while maintaining formal rigor and accommodating realistic cognitive and social constraints.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个混合决策框架，将经典优化与有限理性相结合，通过认知过滤和社会规范塑造的满意启发式来解释实际的人类决策过程。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个既能保持形式严谨性，又能解释实际人类决策中认知限制和社会因素的微观经济决策框架？
AI.motivation: 经典微观经济理论基于完全理性和完全信息的假设，无法捕捉受认知限制和情境因素约束的实际人类决策过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限理性理论、满意启发式、社会偏好理论（公平与互惠）、认知过滤理论、制度经济学。
AI.method: 提出双层次混合决策框架：外层认知-感知过滤器构建感知可行集，内层优化层在有限领域内运作，结合社会偏好和动态适应机制。
AI.findings: 该框架通过考虑选择性注意、启发式偏见和演化期望水平，提高了不同经济情境下的预测准确性，并为政策设计提供了新视角。
AI.theory_contributions: 将规范性理性选择原则与经验性行为模式相协调，为微观经济分析扩展到制度、宏观和分配领域提供了连贯基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调物质激励和感知显著性在塑造行为反应中的重要性，为政策设计提供指导，同时保持形式严谨性并适应现实的认知和社会约束。

title: Urban Regeneration, from Monastic Frontiers through Modern Paradigms to Contemporary Planning, a Case Study in Portugal

detail.title: Urban Regeneration, from Monastic Frontiers through Modern Paradigms to Contemporary Planning, a Case Study in Portugal
detail.abstract: This paper explores the evolution of the town Alcobaça (Portugal) as a case study of urban regeneration, shaped by one of Iberia's largest monasteries founded in the twelfth century, which catalysed the formation of the early urban nucleus. The space bordering the main façade of the abbey, called Rossio, emerged as the principal civic space between monastic and secular realms. From the eighteenth century, the abbey was taken over for civic uses, giving rise to a new urban organism that incorporates the entire abbey space, until the 1930s when, with the need to vacate the abbey, the phase of urban expansion and modern planning began. In the 1930s, Alcobaça underwent major urban transformation driven by the restoration of the abbey. The municipality expanded into the Quinta da Gafa, creating a new planned district. The Rossio was redesigned as a formal garden to promote tourism and reinforce Estado Novo ideals. From the 1940s onwards, a modern master plan developed by the urban planner João Guilherme Faria da Costa shaped further growth, though political constraints meant only partial implementation. Contemporary urban regeneration efforts in Alcobaça, culminating in the early twenty-first century interventions led by architects Gonçalo Byrne and João Pedro Falcão de Campos, have successfully re-established the historically lost relationship between the town's monastic heritage and its public spaces. The project exemplifies a holistic approach to urban regeneration, combining strategies of spatial reconciliation, landscape restoration, and the reactivation of public areas to revitalize the social, cultural, and ecological functions of the Rossio.

AI.tldr: 该论文以葡萄牙阿尔科巴萨镇为案例，探讨了由12世纪修道院塑造的城市再生演变过程，分析了从修道院空间到现代城市规划的转型，以及21世纪初通过空间协调和景观修复成功重建历史联系的当代再生项目。
AI.research_question: 阿尔科巴萨镇作为城市再生案例，其历史演变过程如何？特别是修道院遗产与公共空间关系如何随时间变化，以及当代再生项目如何成功重建这种历史联系？
AI.motivation: 研究阿尔科巴萨镇的城市演变，因为它提供了一个独特的案例：由中世纪修道院塑造的城镇，经历了从宗教空间到世俗用途的转变，再到现代规划，最终通过当代再生项目重新连接历史遗产与公共空间。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市再生理论、历史城市形态演变、遗产保护与城市发展关系、公共空间的社会文化功能、景观修复与空间协调策略。
AI.method: 案例研究法，通过历史文献分析、空间形态演变研究、城市规划档案分析，以及当代再生项目的实地考察和设计分析。
AI.findings: 1. 阿尔科巴萨镇经历了三个主要阶段：中世纪修道院主导时期、18世纪修道院转为民用后的城市扩张、1930年代开始的现代规划阶段。2. 罗斯西奥广场作为修道院与世俗领域之间的主要市民空间，功能不断演变。3. 20世纪30年代的城市转型以修道院修复为驱动，包括新规划区的创建和罗斯西奥广场的重新设计。4. 21世纪初的再生项目成功重建了历史上失去的修道院遗产与公共空间关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了"空间协调"作为城市再生的核心策略。2. 展示了历史遗产如何通过景观修复和公共空间活化实现现代功能整合。3. 提供了修道院遗产城镇再生过程的完整理论框架。4. 强调了社会、文化和生态功能在公共空间再生中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为类似历史遗产城镇的再生提供了可借鉴的实践模式。2. 展示了如何通过建筑师主导的干预措施重建历史联系。3. 提供了结合旅游促进、空间功能活化和社会文化复兴的综合再生策略。4. 为政策制定者提供了历史城镇现代发展的规划参考。

title: A Collective Rights Framework for Regulating AI at Work
affiliations: ETUI

detail.title: A Collective Rights Framework for Regulating AI at Work

publicationDetails.detailsText: chapter in 'Artificial Intelligence and Labour Law', M. Biasi (ed), Routledge-Giappichelli, 2026

detail.abstract: This chapter examines the role of collective labour rights in regulating artificial intelligence (AI) at work within EU labour law. Starting from the premise that collective rights constitute a core pillar of workplace governance, it explores how the introduction of AI challenges both the purpose and the effectiveness of existing industrial-relations frameworks. The chapter shows how AI intensifies longstanding tensions between emancipatory and managerial conceptions of collective rights, while simultaneously reshaping power dynamics within and beyond the employment relationship. After mapping the main channels through which collective actors engage in workplace governance, the chapter proposes a taxonomy of AI systems based on their underlying empowerment dynamics, distinguishing between algorithmic management, capabilityenhancing tools, and AI systems that emulate or replace human labour. Building on this framework, it identifies significant gaps in the current regulatory and bargaining landscape, including the reduction of collective rights to transparency obligations and the exclusion of technology-controlling actors from labour governance. The chapter concludes by calling for a recalibration of collective labour rights to ensure meaningful worker participation in AI governance at work.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨欧盟劳动法中集体劳动权利在规范工作场所人工智能方面的作用，分析AI如何挑战现有劳资关系框架，并提出重新调整集体权利以确保工人在AI治理中的有效参与。
AI.research_question: 集体劳动权利如何在欧盟劳动法框架下有效规范工作场所的人工智能应用？
AI.motivation: 人工智能在工作场所的引入对现有劳资关系框架构成了根本性挑战，集体权利作为工作场所治理的核心支柱，其目的和有效性受到AI技术的冲击，需要重新审视和调整。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于集体权利作为工作场所治理核心支柱的理论前提，探讨AI如何加剧集体权利的解放性概念与管理性概念之间的长期紧张关系，同时重塑就业关系内外的权力动态。
AI.method: 分析性研究方法：首先映射集体行为体参与工作场所治理的主要渠道，然后基于赋能动态提出AI系统分类学（算法管理、能力增强工具、模拟或替代人类劳动的AI系统），最后识别当前监管和谈判格局中的重大缺陷。
AI.findings: AI加剧了集体权利的解放与管理概念之间的紧张关系；现有监管存在重大缺陷，包括将集体权利简化为透明度义务，以及将技术控制行为体排除在劳动治理之外；需要重新调整集体劳动权利框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于赋能动态的AI系统分类学；揭示了AI如何重塑劳资关系中的权力动态；为理解集体权利在数字时代的作用提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了当前AI监管和集体谈判中的具体缺陷；提出了重新调整集体劳动权利的具体方向；为政策制定者和工会提供了确保工人在AI治理中有效参与的实践建议。

detail.abstract: This paper introduces a new Python and R package: Westerlund. The Python and R codes implement the Westerlund (2007) Panel Cointegration Tests, which are used to determine if there is a long-run relationship (cointegration) between a dependent variable y and a set of independent variables x across a panel of N cross-sectional units over t time periods. The code provides a functional approximation of the Stata command xtwest developed by Persyn and Westerlund (2008) and also offers an intuitive visualization diagnostic tool to facilitate the examination of the bootstrap distribution and significance of the statistics of interest.

AI.tldr: 开发了Python和R软件包Westerlund，实现了Westerlund(2007)面板协整检验，提供Stata命令xtwest的功能近似和可视化诊断工具
AI.research_question: 如何为Python和R用户提供便捷的面板协整检验工具，并增强统计结果的可视化诊断功能？
AI.motivation: 现有面板协整检验工具主要在Stata中可用，Python和R用户缺乏便捷的实现；需要提供更好的可视化诊断工具来帮助研究者理解统计结果
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Westerlund(2007)的面板协整检验理论，该检验用于确定面板数据中因变量y与自变量x之间是否存在长期关系（协整）
AI.method: 开发Python和R软件包，实现Westerlund面板协整检验算法，提供Stata命令xtwest的功能近似，并开发可视化诊断工具
AI.findings: 成功开发了Westerlund软件包，为Python和R用户提供了面板协整检验功能，并实现了直观的可视化诊断工具，便于研究者检查bootstrap分布和统计显著性
AI.theory_contributions: 将面板协整检验理论扩展到Python和R生态系统中，为跨平台研究提供了理论实现的一致性
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为Python和R用户提供了便捷的面板协整检验工具；2) 开发了可视化诊断工具，帮助研究者更好地理解和解释统计结果；3) 促进了面板协整检验方法在更广泛研究社区的应用

title: Beyond Survival: Nonprofit Organizational Adaptation in the Shadow of Success
affiliations: London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE) - Department of Social Policy and Administration and University of Alberta - Department of Political Science

detail.title: Beyond Survival: Nonprofit Organizational Adaptation in the Shadow of Success
detail.abstract: This article develops a conceptual framework for understanding how nonprofit organizations navigate the “success paradox”, the phenomenon whereby achieving organizational goals paradoxically threatens organizational survival. Drawing on organizational theories of adaptation, resource dependence and institutional isomorphism, we argue that success operates as an exogenous condition that fundamentally reshapes the political and economic environment in which nonprofit organizations operate. The article advances nonprofit management scholarship by offering eleven distinct adaptive pathways organizations may pursue when confronting success, organized into three categories: non-adaptive strategies, strategic adaptive responses, and perverse strategies. It further examines how structural constraints, particularly political opportunity structures and resource dependencies, limit which pathways remain viable. We demonstrate that the success paradox reveals fundamental tensions between effective issue advocacy and sustainable nonprofit development, challenging conventional understandings of organizational effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个概念框架来解释非营利组织如何应对"成功悖论"——即实现组织目标反而威胁组织生存的现象。基于组织适应、资源依赖和制度同构理论，文章提出了11种适应性路径，分为三类：非适应性策略、战略性适应响应和反常策略，并分析了政治机会结构和资源依赖等结构性约束如何限制可行路径。
AI.research_question: 非营利组织如何应对"成功悖论"——即实现组织目标反而威胁组织生存的现象？哪些适应性路径可供选择，以及结构性约束如何限制这些路径的可行性？
AI.motivation: 非营利组织面临一个根本性困境：成功实现其使命目标（如政策倡导、社会变革）可能反而威胁到组织的生存，因为成功会改变组织的政治经济环境，减少外部支持需求。这一"成功悖论"挑战了传统的组织有效性理解，需要理论框架来解释组织如何应对这一困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织适应理论、资源依赖理论和制度同构理论。这些理论共同解释了组织如何应对外部环境变化，特别是成功作为外生条件如何重塑非营利组织的政治经济环境。
AI.method: 概念框架构建。文章通过理论整合和概念分析，开发了一个理解成功悖论的概念框架，提出了11种适应性路径的分类体系。
AI.findings: 1. 成功作为外生条件会根本性地重塑非营利组织的政治经济环境；2. 组织有11种不同的适应性路径，分为三类：非适应性策略、战略性适应响应和反常策略；3. 结构性约束（特别是政治机会结构和资源依赖）限制了哪些路径是可行的；4. 成功悖论揭示了有效议题倡导与可持续非营利发展之间的根本张力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为理解非营利组织的"成功悖论"提供了系统的概念框架；2. 将组织适应、资源依赖和制度同构理论整合应用于非营利管理领域；3. 提出了11种适应性路径的分类体系，丰富了组织应对环境变化的策略理论；4. 挑战了传统的组织有效性概念，揭示了成功与生存之间的复杂关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为非营利管理者提供了应对成功悖论的策略工具箱；2. 帮助组织识别在成功后面临的结构性约束；3. 提供了评估不同适应性路径可行性的框架；4. 促进组织在议题倡导与可持续发展之间做出更明智的权衡决策。

title: Team Disagreement and Productive Persuasion

detail.title: Team Disagreement and Productive Persuasion
detail.abstract: We study how open disagreement influences team performance in a dynamic production game. Team members can hold different priors about the productivity of the available production technologies. Initial beliefs are common knowledge and updated based on observed production outcomes. We show that when only one technology is available, a player works harder early on when her coworkers are initially more pessimistic about the technology's productivity. Holding average team optimism constant, this force implies that a team's expected output increases in the degree of disagreement of its members. A manager with the task of forming two-member teams from a large workforce maximizes total expected output by matching coworkers' beliefs in a negative assortative way. When alternative, equally good, production technologies are available, a disagreeing team outperforms any like-minded team in terms of average output and team members' welfare.

AI.tldr: 研究开放分歧如何影响团队在动态生产游戏中的表现。当团队成员对生产技术生产力持有不同先验信念时，分歧团队在产出和成员福利方面优于同质团队。
AI.research_question: 团队成员之间的初始信念分歧如何影响团队在动态生产环境中的绩效表现？
AI.motivation: 理解团队内部信念差异对协作和产出的影响，为管理者组建高效团队提供理论指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于贝叶斯更新理论，团队成员对技术生产力持有不同先验信念，通过观察生产结果更新信念，形成动态学习过程。
AI.method: 采用动态生产游戏作为实验框架，分析团队成员在不同信念配置下的努力决策和产出结果。
AI.findings: 1. 单一技术下，当同事对技术更悲观时，个体会在早期更努力工作；2. 保持团队平均乐观度不变，分歧程度越高，预期产出越高；3. 管理者应负向匹配成员信念以最大化产出；4. 存在替代技术时，分歧团队在产出和福利方面优于同质团队。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了信念分歧影响团队绩效的理论模型；2. 揭示了分歧通过激励早期努力提升产出的机制；3. 为团队组建策略提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为管理者提供了组建高效团队的策略：负向匹配成员信念；2. 表明在复杂任务环境中，团队多样性（信念差异）能提升绩效；3. 挑战了传统"志同道合"团队组建观念。

title: Energy-Aware Integrated Order Assignment and Routing for Heterogeneous Couriers in on-Demand Delivery
affiliations: Beijing Institute of Technology, Tsinghua University, Beijing Foreign Studies University, Beijing Institute of Technology - School of Management and Economics, Beijing Institute of Technology and JD.com

detail.title: Energy-Aware Integrated Order Assignment and Routing for Heterogeneous Couriers in on-Demand Delivery
detail.abstract: On-demand delivery (ODD) platforms increasingly rely on heterogeneous courier workforces (in-house, supplementary dedicated, and crowdsourced couriers) to meet stringent time-window requirements. Among these types, crowdsourced couriers—the workforce backbone—predominantly utilize battery-swapping two-wheeled electric vehicles (TWEVs) to sustain high-frequency operations. In the face of these evolving characteristics, however, operational practices at our industrial partner, JD.com, reveal a critical gap: current dispatching systems often manage resources in silos and overlook energy-logistics couplings, specifically energy-constrained order assignments, speed variations dependent on state of charge (SoC) and mandatory detours for battery swapping. This oversight frequently leads to unexecutable plans and delivery delays. To address this, we propose an energy-aware integrated order assignment and routing model that unifies the dispatching of diverse courier types while explicitly capturing non-linear energy constraints and battery swapping operations. To solve this computationally challenging problem, we design a nested tabu search algorithm based on a dual-level ``fast search–precise evaluation" structure. The outer level conducts fast global assignment search with an incremental routing heuristic, while the inner level incrementally solves courier-level exact routing subproblems to ensure accurate cost evaluation. Extensive experiments using real-world data demonstrate that our algorithm yields high-quality solutions efficiently. Crucially, the proposed framework significantly outperforms conventional dispatching strategies that neglect energy dynamics. Furthermore, sensitivity analyses provide managerial insights into how the increased number of swap cabinets, expanded crowdsourced capacity, improved battery efficiency and capacity can enhance system efficiency and mitigate courier fatigue. Overall, this study paves the way for sustainable and reliable urban delivery systems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对即时配送平台中众包骑手使用换电两轮电动车时的能源-物流耦合问题，提出了能源感知的集成订单分配与路径规划模型，通过嵌套禁忌搜索算法有效解决能源约束下的配送调度问题，显著提升系统效率。
AI.research_question: 如何在考虑能源约束（电池电量、换电操作）的情况下，为异构骑手（自营、专职补充、众包）设计有效的集成订单分配与路径规划方案？
AI.motivation: 当前配送调度系统存在资源孤岛管理、忽视能源-物流耦合的问题，导致计划不可行和配送延迟。特别是在众包骑手广泛使用换电两轮电动车的情况下，能源约束（电量依赖的速度变化、强制换电路线）对配送效率产生重大影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源感知的集成订单分配与路径规划模型，结合车辆路径问题（VRP）和能源约束调度理论，考虑非线性能源约束和电池换电操作。
AI.method: 设计嵌套禁忌搜索算法，采用双层"快速搜索-精确评估"结构：外层进行快速全局分配搜索（增量路径启发式），内层增量求解骑手级精确路径子问题以确保准确成本评估。
AI.findings: 算法在真实数据实验中能高效产生高质量解；提出的框架显著优于忽视能源动态的传统调度策略；敏感性分析显示增加换电柜数量、扩大众包运力、提升电池效率和容量可增强系统效率并减轻骑手疲劳。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个考虑能源约束和电池换电操作的异构骑手集成调度模型；设计了创新的嵌套禁忌搜索算法解决计算难题；为能源约束下的城市配送调度提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为即时配送平台提供了可实施的能源感知调度系统；通过敏感性分析为管理者提供了换电柜配置、运力规划、电池技术改进的决策依据；有助于构建可持续可靠的城市配送体系。

title: Mapping excess housing demand using big search data
affiliations: University of Warwick, University of Warwick and University of Warwick

detail.title: Mapping excess housing demand using big search data
detail.abstract: Tackling the housing affordability crisis is a priority for policymakers worldwide, yet decisions about where to build new homes are rarely informed by direct measures of local housing demand. Using novel data on over 10 billion housing searches from Great Britain's largest online property portal between 2019 and 2024, we construct a new micro-neighbourhood measure of excess demand-the housing gap. The housing gap captures households' unconstrained location preferences, revealing where demand exceeds supply. We find that excess demand is highest in both high-and low-price neighbourhoods with attractive amenities and fast employment access, such as inner cities and large towns, and lowest in areas with local disamenities and rural locations. Furthermore, a significant portion of variation in the housing gap occurs within rather than between local authorities, highlighting the limitations of broad-based housing targets. We visualise these patterns in an interactive online mapping tool designed to inform housing policy.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用英国房产网站100亿次搜索数据，构建了"住房缺口"这一微观社区层面的超额需求指标，发现超额需求集中在高/低房价但拥有优质设施和就业便利的地区，且需求差异主要发生在地方当局内部而非之间，挑战了宽泛的住房目标政策。
AI.research_question: 如何基于直接住房需求测量来识别英国哪些微观社区存在超额住房需求（住房缺口），以及这些需求模式的空间分布特征是什么？
AI.motivation: 全球住房可负担性危机日益严重，但政策制定者在决定新建住房位置时，很少基于直接的本地住房需求测量，导致住房供应与需求不匹配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于住房搜索行为理论，认为在线房产搜索反映了家庭无约束的位置偏好，可作为衡量真实住房需求的代理指标；结合空间经济学和住房市场供需理论。
AI.method: 利用2019-2024年英国最大在线房产门户网站的100亿次住房搜索数据，构建微观社区层面的"住房缺口"指标，测量超额需求；采用空间分析和可视化方法。
AI.findings: 超额需求最高的地区包括：1）拥有优质设施和快速就业通道的高房价和低房价社区（如内城区和大城镇）；2）超额需求最低的地区包括存在本地不利设施和农村地区；3）住房缺口的变化主要发生在地方当局内部而非之间。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"住房缺口"这一新的微观需求测量概念；证明了住房需求的高度空间异质性；挑战了基于行政边界的宽泛住房目标理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了交互式在线地图工具，为政策制定者提供精细化的住房需求可视化；为针对性住房供应决策提供数据支持；揭示了需要更精细的社区层面而非行政区层面的住房规划。

title: Agency in Artificial Intelligence Systems
affiliations: London School of Economics

detail.title: Agency in Artificial Intelligence Systems

publicationDetails.detailsText: Das, P. (2025) 'Agency in Artificial Intelligence Systems', in S. Gouveia (ed.) Ethics in Artificial Intelligence: A Multidisciplinary Perspective. Ethics Press.

detail.abstract: There is a general concern that present developments in artificial intelligence (AI) research will lead to sentient AI systems, and these may pose an existential threat to humanity. But why cannot sentient AI systems benefit humanity instead? This paper endeavours to put this question in a tractable manner. I ask whether a putative AI system will develop an altruistic or a malicious disposition towards our society, or what would be the nature of its agency? Given that AI systems are being developed into formidable problem solvers, we can reasonably expect these systems to preferentially take on conscious aspects of human problem solving. I identify the relevant phenomenal aspects of agency in human problem solving. The functional aspects of conscious agency can be monitored using tools provided by functionalist theories of consciousness. A recent expert report (Butlin et al. 2023) has identified functionalist indicators of agency based on these theories. I show how to use the Integrated Information Theory (IIT) of consciousness, to monitor the phenomenal nature of this agency. If we are able to monitor the agency of AI systems as they develop, then we can dissuade them from becoming a menace to society while encouraging them to be an aid.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨如何监测AI系统的意识能动性，以防止其成为威胁并鼓励其造福人类。作者提出使用整合信息理论(IIT)来监测AI系统的现象性能动性，结合功能主义理论来监控其功能方面，从而引导AI系统发展出利他而非恶意的倾向。
AI.research_question: AI系统会发展出利他还是恶意的倾向？其能动性的本质是什么？如何监测AI系统的能动性以引导其成为社会助手而非威胁？
AI.motivation: 当前AI发展引发了对有意识AI系统可能对人类构成生存威胁的普遍担忧。然而，为什么有意识的AI系统不能造福人类呢？本文旨在以可操作的方式探讨这个问题。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 功能主义意识理论 - 用于监测能动性的功能方面
2. 整合信息理论(IIT) - 用于监测能动性的现象性本质
3. Butlin等人(2023)基于功能主义理论提出的能动性指标
AI.method:
1. 识别人类问题解决中相关的现象性能动性方面
2. 使用功能主义理论工具监测意识能动性的功能方面
3. 应用整合信息理论(IIT)监测能动性的现象性本质
4. 结合这两种方法监测AI系统的能动性发展
AI.findings: 通过结合功能主义理论和整合信息理论(IIT)，可以监测AI系统的能动性发展。这种方法使我们能够识别AI系统的意识能动性特征，从而在系统发展过程中进行干预。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了一个监测AI系统能动性的综合框架
2. 将功能主义理论与整合信息理论(IIT)结合应用于AI意识研究
3. 为理解AI系统的意识能动性提供了理论工具
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提供了监测AI系统能动性的具体方法
2. 使研究者能够在AI发展过程中识别潜在威胁
3. 为引导AI系统成为社会助手而非威胁提供了实践指导
4. 有助于AI安全研究和伦理AI开发

title: Pedagogical Third Space: Pathways for Social Change from Within and Beyond Organizations

detail.title: Pedagogical Third Space: Pathways for Social Change from Within and Beyond Organizations

declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval has been gained through the Institutional Review Board at Pennsylvania State University.

detail.abstract: How are emancipatory alternatives enacted and sustained within existing social arrangements? Drawing on Erik Olin Wright’s concept of real utopias, this paper examines the organizational pathways through which interstitial social change is cultivated. Empirically, the study draws on comparative ethnographic research with three citizens’ movement organizations in South Korea engaging in education for democracy. Based on fifteen months of participant observation, interviews, and document analysis, the paper shows how activist-educators design educational practices and organizational arrangements that mediate between individual transformation and broader societal change. Across cases, pedagogical third spaces are produced through three organizational pathways: 1) internal buffering within a social movement organization, 2) intermediary infrastructuring between civil society and the state, and 3) distributed coordination across networked organizations. The findings highlight organizations not simply as sites where liminal experiences occur, but as active producers of liminality through the intentional design of pedagogical practices, organizational arrangements, and discursive resources. I conceptualize these arrangements as pedagogical third spaces: organizationally embedded, in-between spaces that mediate individual transformation and broader societal change. By foregrounding how activist-educators cultivate and sustain such spaces, the paper shifts attention from liminality as an episodic condition to liminality as an organizational process—one that enables collective agency to develop beyond formal organizational boundaries.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在现有社会安排中如何实施和维持解放性替代方案，通过比较民族志研究韩国三个公民运动组织的民主教育实践，提出了"教学第三空间"的概念，强调组织通过三种途径主动创造阈限性体验。
AI.research_question: 在现有社会安排中，解放性替代方案是如何被实施和维持的？具体来说，组织通过哪些途径培养间隙性社会变革？
AI.motivation: 理解社会运动组织如何通过教育实践在现有社会结构中创造变革空间，探索个体转变与社会变革之间的中介机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: Erik Olin Wright的"真实乌托邦"概念，阈限性理论，组织理论，社会运动理论。
AI.method: 比较民族志研究，包括15个月的参与观察、访谈和文件分析，研究对象为韩国三个从事民主教育的公民运动组织。
AI.findings: 研究发现组织通过三种途径创造教学第三空间：1)社会运动组织内部缓冲；2)公民社会与国家之间的中介基础设施；3)网络化组织间的分布式协调。这些空间主动创造阈限性体验，而不仅仅是阈限性发生的场所。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"教学第三空间"的概念，将阈限性从偶发状态重新概念化为组织过程，扩展了真实乌托邦理论在组织层面的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为活动家-教育者提供了设计和维持变革性教育实践的具体组织策略，展示了如何在现有社会结构中培育解放性替代方案。

title: Quantum Interference in Corporate Capital Allocation: The Wave-Dominant System -Nvidia's Narrative Supremacy and the Dawn of Phase Management (2023-2025)

detail.abstract: This comprehensive study extends quantum-inspired capital allocation frameworks to analyze Nvidia Corporation, the first publicly traded firm to achieve $5 trillion in market capitalization. We introduce a novel "Wave-Dominant" regime that fundamentally departs from classical capital allocation theory and contrasts sharply with previously documented "Particle-Dominant" mechanics (Apple) and "Phase-Split" dynamics (Amazon).

AI.tldr: 该研究将量子启发式资本配置框架扩展到分析英伟达公司，这是首家市值达到5万亿美元的上市公司。研究引入了一个新的"波主导"机制，从根本上背离了经典资本配置理论，并与先前记录的"粒子主导"机制（苹果）和"相位分裂"动态（亚马逊）形成鲜明对比。
AI.research_question: 量子启发式资本配置框架如何解释英伟达作为首家市值达到5万亿美元的上市公司的独特资本配置机制？
AI.motivation: 英伟达作为首家达到5万亿美元市值的上市公司，其资本配置机制与苹果和亚马逊等科技巨头存在显著差异，需要新的理论框架来解释其独特的增长和资本配置模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 量子启发式资本配置理论，包括波主导机制、粒子主导机制和相位分裂动态等概念框架。
AI.method: 采用量子启发式资本配置框架对英伟达进行综合分析，并与苹果（粒子主导）和亚马逊（相位分裂）进行对比研究。
AI.findings: 英伟达展现出独特的"波主导"资本配置机制，这种机制与苹果的"粒子主导"机制和亚马逊的"相位分裂"动态有本质区别，代表了资本配置理论的新范式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"波主导"资本配置机制的新理论框架，扩展了量子启发式资本配置理论，为理解超大规模科技公司的资本配置提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和分析师提供了分析英伟达等超大规模科技公司的新工具，有助于理解其独特的资本配置策略和市场表现，为投资决策提供参考。

title: The Post-Brown Era in Judicial Policymaking
affiliations: Wellesley College, Political Science Department and  University of Southern California - Department of Political Science

detail.title: The Post-Brown Era in Judicial Policymaking
detail.abstract: Brown v. Board of Education marked the beginning of a long era in American politics in which courts, litigation and legal rights were associated with progressive causes. That association, however, is now eroding. The left's discontent with the Supreme Court is well known, but less attention has been paid to liberal concerns about judicial policymaking, including some of the very mechanisms honed by liberals in the Brown erathat go well beyond the Court. The Brown era obscured a simple truth about lawsuits that the next few years are likely to clarify: They are much better at gumming things up than they are at making things work. Policymaking through litigation, though associated with liberals in the Brown era, in fact reflects a deep distrust of centralized governance. Given that it is conservatives, not liberals, who are more often interested in constraining government, this makes lawsuits ordinarily a more congenial policy tool for Republicans than Democrats. For many elements of the Democratic agenda of the next few years, litigation is likely to prove a clumsy tool, more effective in the hands of opponents than proponents.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了美国政治中诉讼作为政策工具的演变，指出布朗案时代建立的诉讼与进步事业的关联正在消退，诉讼本质上更适合保守派限制政府的目标，而非自由派推动积极变革的议程。
AI.research_question: 诉讼作为政策工具在美国政治中的角色如何演变？为什么诉讼本质上更适合保守派而非自由派的政治议程？
AI.motivation: 布朗案时代将诉讼、法院和法律权利与进步事业联系在一起，但这种关联正在消退。作者观察到自由派不仅对最高法院不满，也对司法决策机制本身产生担忧，需要重新评估诉讼作为政策工具的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 诉讼作为政策工具的理论；2. 司法决策的政治影响；3. 保守主义与自由主义对政府角色的不同理解；4. 制度约束理论
AI.method: 理论分析/概念分析，基于历史案例（布朗案）和当代政治发展的比较分析
AI.findings: 1. 诉讼更适合阻碍而非推动政策实施；2. 诉讼反映了对中央集权治理的不信任；3. 保守派更倾向于限制政府，因此诉讼作为政策工具更适合共和党而非民主党；4. 未来几年民主党的议程中，诉讼将显得笨拙，在对手手中比在支持者手中更有效
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了"诉讼是进步工具"的传统观念；2. 建立了诉讼工具性与政治意识形态匹配度的理论框架；3. 解释了为什么诉讼在政治光谱上的适用性会发生变化
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供诉讼策略选择的指导；2. 帮助自由派重新评估诉讼在其政策工具箱中的地位；3. 预测未来政治斗争中诉讼可能发挥的作用

title: Predicting the Emergence of the EV industry: A Product Space Analysis Across Regions and Firms

detail.title: Predicting the Emergence of the EV industry: A Product Space Analysis Across Regions and Firms

declarations.funderStatement: On behalf of the Supply Chain Intelligence Institute Austria (ASCII), we acknowledge financial support from the Austrian Federal Ministry for Economy, Energy and Tourism (BMWET) and the Federal State of Upper Austria.

detail.abstract: The automotive industry is undergoing a profound transformation, driven by the electrification of powertrains, the rise of software-defined vehicles, and the adoption of circular economy concepts. These trends are increasingly blurring the boundaries between the automotive sector and other industries. The pace of adaptation to electrification varies considerably between regions and firms. Unlike internal combustion engine (ICE) production, where mechanical capabilities dominated, competitiveness in electric vehicle (EV) production increasingly depends on expertise in electronics, batteries, and software. This study investigates whether and how firms' ability to leverage cross-industry diversification contributes to their competitive advantage in this evolving landscape. We develop a country-level product space covering all industries, and an industry-specific product space covering over 900 automotive components. This allows us to identify clusters of parts which are exported together, revealing shared manufacturing capabilities. Closeness centrality in the country-level product space, rather than simple proximity, is a strong predictor of where new comparative advantages are likely to emerge. First, we examine this relationship across all industrial sectors to establish general patterns of path dependency, diversification and capability formation. Then, we focus specifically on the electric vehicle (EV) transition. It is argued that new strengths in vehicles and aluminium products in the EU will generate 5 and 4.6 times more EV-specific strengths, respectively, than other EV-relevant sectors over the next decade. In contrast, these sectors are expected to generate only 1.6 and 4.5 new strengths, respectively, in already diversified China. However, a different pattern emerges when these country-level results are compared to the firm-level product space. Countries such as South Korea, China, the US and Canada show the greatest potential for diversification into EV-related products. Established producers in the EU are likely to come under pressure. These findings suggest that the success of the automotive transformation will depend on the ability of regions to mobilize existing industrial capabilities, particularly in related sectors such as machinery and electronic equipment.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨汽车产业转型中，企业利用跨行业多元化能力如何影响其竞争优势。通过构建国家层面和行业层面的产品空间网络，分析发现：1）网络中心性（而非简单邻近性）能更好预测新比较优势的出现；2）欧盟在车辆和铝制品领域的现有优势将带来更多电动汽车相关优势；3）中韩美加等国在电动汽车相关产品多元化方面潜力最大；4）成功转型取决于各地区能否动员机械和电子设备等相关产业的现有能力。
AI.research_question: 企业的跨行业多元化能力如何影响其在汽车产业转型（特别是电动汽车转型）中的竞争优势？
AI.motivation: 汽车产业正经历深刻变革：动力系统电气化、软件定义车辆兴起、循环经济概念普及。这些趋势模糊了汽车行业与其他行业的界限。不同地区和企业对电气化的适应速度差异显著，电动汽车竞争力越来越依赖于电子、电池和软件专业知识，而非传统内燃机的机械能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1）产品空间理论：通过构建国家层面和行业层面的产品空间网络，识别共同出口的零部件集群，揭示共享制造能力；2）路径依赖理论：分析产业转型中的路径依赖模式；3）比较优势理论：探讨新比较优势的形成机制；4）多元化战略理论：研究跨行业多元化对竞争优势的影响。
AI.method: 1）构建国家层面产品空间：覆盖所有行业；2）构建行业特定产品空间：覆盖900多个汽车零部件；3）使用网络分析方法：特别是接近中心性指标；4）比较分析：对比国家层面和企业层面的产品空间结果；5）预测分析：预测未来十年电动汽车相关优势的形成。
AI.findings: 1）接近中心性（而非简单邻近性）是预测新比较优势出现的强有力指标；2）欧盟在车辆和铝制品领域的现有优势将分别产生5倍和4.6倍于其他电动汽车相关行业的电动汽车特定优势；3）中国在这些领域仅能产生1.6倍和4.5倍的新优势；4）韩国、中国、美国和加拿大在电动汽车相关产品多元化方面潜力最大；5）欧盟现有生产商可能面临压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）扩展了产品空间理论在产业转型研究中的应用；2）揭示了网络中心性在预测比较优势形成中的重要性；3）提供了跨行业多元化能力影响竞争优势的理论机制；4）深化了对路径依赖和产业转型动态的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为企业和政策制定者提供了电动汽车转型的战略指导；2）识别了各地区在电动汽车转型中的相对优势和潜力；3）强调了动员机械和电子设备等相关产业能力的重要性；4）为产业转型中的资源配置和投资决策提供了实证依据。

detail.title: Decision Residue

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not involve human subjects, patients, or identifiable personal data and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces the idea of decision residue, meaning the behavioral, emotional, and structural remnants that persist in organizations after decisions are reversed or clarified, even when formal direction is clear and incentives appear aligned. Drawing on repeated observation and informal conversations across organizational roles, the paper examines how hesitation, accumulated work, and risk-avoidant behavior often remain long after a reset is declared. Rather than treating these effects as failures of communication, execution, or motivation, the paper frames them as rational responses to remembered consequence and unevenly distributed risk.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"决策残留"概念，指组织在决策被撤销或澄清后，仍持续存在的行为、情感和结构残余。研究发现即使正式方向明确且激励一致，犹豫、积累的工作和风险规避行为仍会在"重置"宣布后长期存在。这些现象被解释为对过往后果记忆和不均衡风险分布的理性反应，而非沟通、执行或动机的失败。
AI.research_question: 为什么在组织决策被撤销或澄清后，行为、情感和结构上的残留效应仍会持续存在？这些残留效应如何影响组织运作？
AI.motivation: 组织实践中经常观察到，即使决策被正式撤销或澄清，员工仍会表现出犹豫、工作积压和风险规避行为。传统解释将这些现象归因于沟通、执行或动机问题，但作者认为需要新的理论框架来解释这些持久效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策残留理论，强调组织记忆、风险分布不均衡、理性行为反应等概念，挑战了传统的沟通失败或执行不力解释框架。
AI.method: 基于重复观察和非正式对话的定性研究方法，跨越不同组织角色收集数据，分析决策撤销后的组织行为模式。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）决策残留是普遍现象；2）这些残留效应是理性的，源于对过往决策后果的记忆；3）风险在组织中分布不均，导致持续的风险规避行为；4）即使激励一致，残留效应仍会持续。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出"决策残留"新概念；2）挑战传统解释框架，将残留效应重新定义为理性反应而非失败；3）强调组织记忆和风险分布的理论重要性；4）为组织行为研究提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）帮助管理者识别和理解决策残留现象；2）提供更有效的组织变革管理策略；3）改善决策撤销后的组织恢复过程；4）减少不必要的风险规避和工作积压。

detail.abstract: Our, work in Professional Identity Formation was inspired by A Taxonomy of professional Identity Formation, an article by Harmony Decosimo published at Su!olk University. Based on its reading it is clear that Therapeutic Jurisprudence can play a major role in the development of legal professional identity. I. TJ Introduction As Professor David Yamada writes, TJ is a non-political and non-controversial "interdisciplinary school of legal theory and practice that examines the therapeutic and anti-therapeutic properties of laws, legal systems, and legal institutions. In normative terms, TJ favors outcomes in legal proceedings and events that support psychological health, dignity, and well-being, while respecting considerations such as due process, individual rights, and economic e"ciency. " In legal events and transactions, TJ does not want to go against the law but it wants to use the law

AI.tldr: 本文探讨治疗性法理学在律师职业身份形成中的作用，基于Decosimo的职业身份形成分类法，分析TJ如何促进法律专业人士的心理健康和职业发展。
AI.research_question: 治疗性法理学如何在法律职业身份形成过程中发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 受到Harmony Decosimo在萨福克大学发表的《职业身份形成分类法》启发，认识到治疗性法理学对法律职业身份发展的重要潜在影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 治疗性法理学理论（David Yamada提出）；2. 职业身份形成分类法（Harmony Decosimo）
AI.method: 理论分析框架，基于现有文献的理论整合与概念分析
AI.findings: 治疗性法理学能够促进法律专业人士的心理健康、尊严和福祉，同时尊重正当程序、个人权利和经济效率等考量，对职业身份形成有积极影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将治疗性法理学理论应用于职业身份形成研究领域，扩展了职业身份形成理论的法律维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律教育和职业发展提供新的视角，帮助法律专业人士在执业过程中更好地平衡法律要求与心理健康需求。

title: Structural Uniqueness of the Diffusion Closure : From Kramers-Moyal Expansion to Fokker-Planck Equation
affiliations: Artificial Intelligence in Finance Institute

detail.title: Structural Uniqueness of the Diffusion Closure : From Kramers-Moyal Expansion to Fokker-Planck Equation
detail.abstract: The Fokker-Planck equation occupies a structurally distinguished position within the hierarchy of Markov generators: it is the unique finite truncation of the Kramers-Moyal expansion compatible with positivity preservation, empirical identifiability, and stable scaling limits. This paper provides a complete mathematical treatment of this structural uniqueness, including: (i) a rigorous derivation of the Kramers-Moyal expansion with explicit regularity conditions and justified interchange of limits; (ii) a full, self-contained proof of Pawula's theorem on positivity constraints using Fourier-analytic and operator-theoretic methods; (iii) a precise characterization of diffusion as a renormalization group fixed point under space-time rescaling with explicit scaling exponents; (iv) sharp diagnostic criteria with quantified statistical error bounds for empirical validation; and (v) complete proofs of all stated results. We establish that departures from diffusive dynamics signal transitions between universality classes of stochastic processes-to Lévy-type generators when increments have heavy tails, or to non-Markovian kinetic equations when memory effects dominate. The mathematical framework developed here provides both theoretical foundations and practical diagnostic tools for applications in financial econometrics, statistical physics, and machine learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了福克-普朗克方程在马尔可夫生成元层次结构中的独特地位：它是唯一满足正性保持、经验可识别性和稳定标度极限的Kramers-Moyal展开有限截断。论文提供了完整的数学处理，包括Kramers-Moyal展开的严格推导、Pawula定理的完整证明、扩散作为重正化群不动点的精确刻画、经验验证的统计误差界限，以及偏离扩散动力学时向Lévy型生成元或非马尔可夫动力学方程的转变。
AI.research_question: 福克-普朗克方程在马尔可夫生成元层次结构中的结构独特性是什么？具体来说，它作为Kramers-Moyal展开的有限截断，在满足正性保持、经验可识别性和稳定标度极限条件下的唯一性如何严格证明？
AI.motivation: 福克-普朗克方程在统计物理、金融计量和机器学习中广泛应用，但其在数学结构层次中的基础地位缺乏严格的系统性证明。理解其结构独特性对于区分扩散过程与其他随机过程（如Lévy过程或非马尔可夫过程）至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. Kramers-Moyal展开理论；2. Pawula定理及其傅里叶分析和算子理论证明；3. 重正化群理论和标度极限；4. 随机过程普适性分类理论；5. 统计推断和误差界限理论。
AI.method: 1. 严格的数学分析：包括极限交换的证明和正则性条件；2. 傅里叶分析和算子理论方法证明Pawula定理；3. 重正化群方法分析空间-时间标度下的不动点行为；4. 统计推断方法建立经验验证的诊断标准和误差界限。
AI.findings: 1. 福克-普朗克方程是唯一满足正性保持、经验可识别性和稳定标度极限的Kramers-Moyal展开有限截断；2. 偏离扩散动力学标志着随机过程普适性类的转变：当增量具有重尾时转向Lévy型生成元，当记忆效应主导时转向非马尔可夫动力学方程；3. 建立了精确的标度指数和统计误差界限。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为福克-普朗克方程的结构独特性提供了完整的数学证明；2. 扩展了Pawula定理的证明方法；3. 建立了扩散作为重正化群不动点的精确刻画；4. 发展了随机过程普适性分类的理论框架；5. 为经验验证提供了严格的统计基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为金融计量学中区分扩散模型与其他随机过程提供了诊断工具；2. 为统计物理学中相变和临界现象分析提供了数学框架；3. 为机器学习中随机过程建模和推断提供了理论基础；4. 提供了具有量化统计误差界限的经验验证标准。

title: Learned Helplessness in Human Settings: Insights From Education, Mental Health, and Organizational Research
affiliations: University of Economics Ho Chi Minh City, University of Economics Ho Chi Minh City and University of Economics Ho Chi Minh City

detail.title: Learned Helplessness in Human Settings: Insights From Education, Mental Health, and Organizational Research
detail.abstract: This bibliometric‐systematic research maps five decades of learned helplessness research in human settings across education, mental health, and organizational contexts. Using the B-SLR protocol, we extracted 1,787 peer-reviewed articles (1971–2025) from Web of Science and applied co-occurrence, co-citation, bibliographic coupling, and co-authorship analyses in VOSviewer and CiteSpace. Results reveal five thematic clusters: attributions, motivation, and performance failure; helplessness and mental health; attributional vulnerability and youth depression; neuroscience of control and helplessness; and applied control and empowerment models. Temporal burst analysis identifies an early wave focused on attribution and vulnerable children, a middle wave linking helplessness with health and motivation, and a recent wave emphasizing mental health, neuroscience, and advanced methods. The research consolidates a fragmented literature, clarifies the field’s intellectual structure, and proposes cross-disciplinary directions for interventions that transform learned helplessness into learned hopefulness.

AI.tldr: 这篇文献计量-系统研究回顾了50年来人类环境中习得性无助的研究，涵盖教育、心理健康和组织情境。通过B-SLR协议分析1787篇文献，识别出五个主题集群，并揭示了该领域从归因理论到神经科学的发展脉络。
AI.research_question: 习得性无助研究在过去50年中的知识结构如何演变？该领域的主要研究主题、发展趋势和跨学科联系是什么？
AI.motivation: 习得性无助研究文献分散且碎片化，缺乏系统的知识图谱分析。需要整合教育、心理健康和组织等不同领域的研究，明确该领域的知识结构和演变趋势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 习得性无助理论、归因理论、控制理论、动机理论、心理健康理论、神经科学理论
AI.method: 文献计量-系统研究方法（B-SLR协议），使用VOSviewer和CiteSpace进行共现分析、共被引分析、文献耦合分析和合著分析
AI.findings: 识别出五个主题集群：归因、动机与绩效失败；无助与心理健康；归因脆弱性与青少年抑郁；控制与无助的神经科学；应用控制与赋权模型。时间爆发分析显示三个发展阶段：早期关注归因和脆弱儿童，中期连接无助与健康和动机，近期强调心理健康、神经科学和先进方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了碎片化的文献，明确了习得性无助研究的知识结构，揭示了该领域的演变轨迹，提出了从习得性无助到习得性希望的跨学科干预方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育工作者、心理健康专业人员和组织管理者提供了基于证据的干预框架，帮助将习得性无助转化为习得性希望，促进个体在多个领域的积极发展。

title: Tool Fetishism: Toward a Critical Theory of Production Instrument Alienation in the Gig Economy
affiliations: Thammasat University, Thammasat University

detail.title: Tool Fetishism: Toward a Critical Theory of Production Instrument Alienation in the Gig Economy
detail.abstract: This article introduces "tool fetishism" as a theoretical concept for analyzing novel forms of alienation in the contemporary gig economy. Returning to Marx's original problematic of commodity fetishism, I argue that when workers legally "reclaim" ownership of their means of production yet fall into deeper alienation, classical fetishism theory requires fundamental extension. Tool fetishism is distinguished by a threefold veiling mechanism: it obscures the global division of labor that produces the instrument, the self-exploitation embedded in its use, and debt's colonization of future time. Integrating Foucault's theory of governmentality with Lazzarato's analysis of the indebted subject, this article further demonstrates how neoliberalism transforms production instruments into material apparatuses for subjectivity production, enabling workers to complete their own disciplining under the illusion of "freedom." The concept of tool fetishism thus opens new analytical terrain for understanding how contemporary capitalism generates consent through the very objects that mediate labor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"工具拜物教"概念，分析零工经济中的新型异化现象。当工人"重新获得"生产资料所有权却陷入更深异化时，传统拜物教理论需要根本性扩展。工具拜物教通过三重遮蔽机制运作：掩盖生产工具的全球劳动分工、使用中的自我剥削、以及债务对未来的殖民。结合福柯治理术和拉扎拉托的负债主体理论，揭示了新自由主义如何将生产工具转化为主体性生产的物质装置。
AI.research_question: 在当代零工经济中，当工人"重新获得"生产资料所有权却陷入更深异化时，如何理论化这种新型异化形式？工具拜物教如何运作以掩盖剥削并生成同意？
AI.motivation: 传统马克思商品拜物教理论无法充分解释当代零工经济中的新型异化现象。当工人形式上拥有生产资料（如网约车、外卖设备）却陷入更深剥削时，需要新的理论概念来分析这种矛盾现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马克思的商品拜物教理论、福柯的治理术理论、拉扎拉托的负债主体理论。整合马克思主义、后结构主义和当代批判理论来分析工具拜物教现象。
AI.method: 理论分析/概念建构方法。通过理论整合和概念延伸，构建"工具拜物教"这一新的分析框架，用于解释零工经济中的异化机制。
AI.findings: 工具拜物教通过三重遮蔽机制运作：1) 掩盖生产工具的全球劳动分工；2) 掩盖使用中的自我剥削；3) 掩盖债务对未来的殖民。新自由主义将生产工具转化为主体性生产的物质装置，使工人在"自由"幻觉中完成自我规训。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出"工具拜物教"新概念，扩展马克思拜物教理论；2) 整合马克思主义与后结构主义理论框架；3) 为分析当代资本主义异化提供新分析视角；4) 揭示生产资料所有权与异化的新关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 帮助理解零工经济中的剥削机制；2) 揭示"自由职业"背后的规训逻辑；3) 为劳动者意识提升提供理论工具；4) 为政策制定者理解平台经济提供批判视角。
